attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this exclusion applies blanket to all insured risks under the coverage or only to specific risks.

tag_set.value: Applies to All Insured Risks Flag

attributes.name: applies_to_first_party
attributes.business_glossary_term: Applies to First Party Coverage Flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this exclusion applies to first-party coverage under the policy.

tag_set.value: Applies to First Party Coverage Flag

attributes.name: applies_to_third_party
attributes.business_glossary_term: Applies to Third Party Liability Flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this exclusion applies to third-party liability coverage under the policy.

tag_set.value: Applies to Third Party Liability Flag

attributes.name: buyback_endorsement_available
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether a standard endorsement exists to buy back coverage for this exclusion.

attributes.name: buyback_premium_amount
attributes.description: Additional premium charged to waive or buy back this exclusion, if applicable. Null if exclusion is not waivable.

attributes.name: exclusion_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of what dimension the exclusion applies to: specific peril, property type, activity, location, person, time period, condition, or other.

attributes.name: claims_made_trigger
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this exclusion applies only to claims-made policies or claims-made coverage triggers.

attributes.name: exclusion_code
attributes.description: Standard code identifying the exclusion type. May be ISO (Insurance Services Office) standard code or carrier-specific manuscript code.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this exclusion record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: exclusion_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of what perils, circumstances, or losses are excluded from coverage under this exclusion clause.
attributes.references: ISO Policy Forms, Policy Contract Language

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this exclusion applies to the coverage. Must align with policy term or endorsement effective date.
attributes.references: Policy Administration System, NAIC Model Laws

attributes.name: endorsement_effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the endorsement introducing this exclusion became effective.

attributes.name: endorsement_number
attributes.description: Policy endorsement number that introduced or modified this exclusion, if applicable.

attributes.name: exclusion_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the exclusion: active and in force, inactive, superseded by a later endorsement, deleted, or pending approval.

attributes.name: exclusion_type
attributes.description: Classification of the exclusion origin: ISO standard form, manuscript custom language, endorsement-based, statutory requirement, regulatory mandate, or carrier-specific.
attributes.references: ISO Forms Library, State DOI Regulations

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which this exclusion ceases to apply. Nullable for exclusions that remain in force through policy term expiration.

attributes.name: iso_form_number
attributes.description: ISO standard form number if this exclusion is derived from an ISO policy form or endorsement.

attributes.name: language_text
attributes.description: Full legal text of the exclusion clause as it appears in the policy contract or endorsement.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this exclusion record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: exclusion_name
attributes.description: Short business-friendly name of the exclusion for display and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: occurrence_trigger
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this exclusion applies to occurrence-based policies or occurrence coverage triggers.

attributes.name: regulatory_mandate_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this exclusion is mandated by state or federal regulation and cannot be waived.
attributes.references: State DOI Regulations, NAIC Model Laws

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Scope level at which the exclusion operates: coverage-level, policy-wide, location-specific, vehicle-specific, driver-specific, building-specific, or other.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of this exclusion record in the source policy administration system.

attributes.name: state_mandate_code
attributes.description: State jurisdiction code if this exclusion is mandated by a specific state Department of Insurance regulation.

attributes.name: underwriter_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes from the underwriter explaining the rationale for applying this exclusion or any special handling instructions.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version number of this exclusion record, incremented with each endorsement or modification.

attributes.name: waivable_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this exclusion can be waived or bought back through an endorsement or additional premium.

products.name: rate
products.description: Rate element applied to a coverage during pricing: rate code, rate basis, rate value, territory factor, class factor, and effective date. Supports reconstruction of premium at any point in time.

attributes.name: rate_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the rate element applied to a coverage during pricing.

attributes.name: coverage_id
attributes.description: Reference to the coverage to which this rate element applies.

attributes.name: geography_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to catastrophegeography.geography. Business justification: Rates are territory-specific; territory_code is denormalized geography reference.

attributes.name: line_of_business_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.classification_code. Business justification: Rating requires formal link to classification code master for base rate lookup, hazard group assignment, loss cost retrieval, and regulatory filing compliance.

attributes.name: policy_term_id
attributes.description: Reference to the policy term during which this rate is effective.

attributes.name: basis_code
attributes.description: The unit of measure to which the rate applies: per hundred of coverage, per thousand, per unit, per vehicle, per location, per employee, per payroll unit, or flat amount.

attributes.name: rate_code
attributes.description: The unique code identifying the rate element in the rating engine or rate table.

attributes.name: coinsurance_factor
attributes.description: Factor applied when coinsurance provisions are in effect, adjusting premium based on the ratio of insurance to value.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this rate record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: deductible_credit_factor
attributes.description: Credit factor applied to reduce premium when a deductible is selected, reflecting reduced carrier exposure.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which this rate element becomes effective for premium calculation.

attributes.name: endorsement_number
attributes.description: Endorsement number if this rate element was added or modified via a policy endorsement.

attributes.name: experience_modifier
attributes.description: Experience modification factor applied to adjust premium based on the insureds historical loss experience. Typically ranges from 0.500 to 2.000.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which this rate element expires and is no longer valid for premium calculation. Null indicates no expiration.

attributes.name: factor
attributes.description: Multiplicative factor applied to base rate for territory, class, or experience adjustments. Typically a decimal multiplier.

attributes.name: filing_approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the state Department of Insurance (DOI) approved this rate for use.

attributes.name: filing_number
attributes.description: The regulatory filing number under which this rate was approved by the state Department of Insurance (DOI).

attributes.name: filing_state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter state code where this rate was filed and approved. Rates are state-specific in Property and Casualty insurance.

attributes.name: increased_limits_factor
attributes.description: Factor applied when coverage limits exceed the base limit, reflecting the increased exposure. Common in liability coverages.

attributes.name: iso_form_number
attributes.description: ISO form number associated with this rate element, linking the rate to standardized policy forms and endorsements.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this rate record was last modified, supporting audit trail and premium reconstruction.

attributes.name: minimum_premium_amount
attributes.description: The minimum premium amount that must be charged for this coverage, regardless of calculated premium. Ensures carrier covers administrative costs.

attributes.name: override_approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the rate override was approved.

attributes.name: override_approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the underwriter or manager who approved the rate override.

attributes.name: override_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rate was manually overridden by an underwriter, deviating from the standard rating algorithm.

attributes.name: override_reason
attributes.description: Business justification for the rate override, required for audit and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: rating_algorithm_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the rating algorithm or pricing model used to calculate this rate element.

attributes.name: rating_variable_name
attributes.description: Name of the rating variable or input factor used in the rating algorithm for this rate element.

attributes.name: rating_variable_value
attributes.description: The value of the rating variable at the time of rating, captured for premium reconstruction and audit purposes.

attributes.name: schedule_credit_debit_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of schedule credit (negative) or debit (positive) applied for underwriting judgment factors such as management quality, safety programs, or loss control.

attributes.name: schedule_credit_debit_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage credit (negative) or debit (positive) applied for underwriting judgment factors. Expressed as a percentage of base premium.

attributes.name: sequence_number
attributes.description: Sequence number for ordering multiple rate elements applied to the same coverage within a policy term.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the source system from which this rate element originated, such as the rating engine or policy administration system.

attributes.name: table_name
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the rate table from which this rate element was retrieved.

attributes.name: table_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the rate table, enabling reconstruction of premium at any point in time using the correct rate version.

attributes.name: transaction_type_code
attributes.description: Type of policy transaction that introduced or modified this rate element: New Business (NB), Renewal (REN), Endorsement (END), Cancellation (CAN), or Reinstatement (RI).

attributes.name: type_code
attributes.description: Classification of the rate element: base rate, territory factor, class factor, experience modifier, schedule credit or debit, discretionary adjustment, minimum premium, or flat charge.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The numeric rate value or factor applied during premium calculation. Precision supports actuarial rating accuracy.

products.name: condition
products.description: One row per contract Condition per Coverage. Attaches named Conditions to a Coverage and Policy Term, completing the VREQ-004 quartet alongside Limit, Deductible, and Exclusion.

attributes.name: condition_id
attributes.description: Represents the condition id value associated with the condition entity in the coverage domain.

attributes.name: condition_policy_transaction_id
attributes.description: Policy transaction (endorsement, new business, renewal) that introduced or last modified this condition.

attributes.name: coverage_id
attributes.description: coverage.coverage.coverage_id

attributes.name: policy_term_id
attributes.description: policy.term.term_id

attributes.name: waived_by_party_id
attributes.description: description

attributes.name: breach_consequence
attributes.description: description

attributes.name: condition_category
attributes.description: description

attributes.name: condition_code
attributes.description: Carrier or ISO form code identifying the standard condition text, e.g. ISO form number or internal code.

attributes.name: compliance_due_date
attributes.description: Date by which the insured must demonstrate compliance with the condition.

attributes.name: compliance_required
attributes.description: description

attributes.name: compliance_required_flag
attributes.description: Represents the compliance required flag value associated with the condition entity in the coverage domain.

attributes.name: compliance_verified_date
attributes.description: Date on which underwriting confirmed the insured satisfied this condition.

attributes.name: compliance_verified_flag
attributes.description: Represents the compliance verified flag value associated with the condition entity in the coverage domain.

attributes.name: condition_status
attributes.description: Represents the condition status value associated with the condition entity in the coverage domain.

attributes.name: condition_type
attributes.description: Classifies the condition: WARRANTY, CONDITION_PRECEDENT, CONDITION_SUBSEQUENT, SPECIAL_PROVISION, REPORTING_REQUIREMENT, OTHER.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this condition record was first inserted.

attributes.name: condition_description
attributes.description: Full text or summary of the contractual condition as it appears on the policy form.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this condition is in force on the coverage. Supports mid-term endorsement of conditions.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which this condition ceases to apply. Null means the condition runs to the end of the policy term.

attributes.name: form_number
attributes.description: Represents the form number value associated with the condition entity in the coverage domain.

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: description

attributes.name: is_mandatory
attributes.description: TRUE if the condition is a mandatory statutory or regulatory requirement; FALSE if it is a negotiated or optional provision.

attributes.name: is_satisfied
attributes.description: Tracks whether the insured has fulfilled the condition. NULL = not yet evaluated; TRUE = satisfied; FALSE = breached.

attributes.name: iso_condition_code
attributes.description: description

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Represents the last modified timestamp value associated with the condition entity in the coverage domain.

attributes.name: mandatory_flag
attributes.description: Represents the mandatory flag value associated with the condition entity in the coverage domain.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this condition record.

attributes.name: non_compliance_action
attributes.description: Action taken if condition is not met: CANCEL, ENDORSE, SURCHARGE, NOTIFY, NONE.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text underwriter or compliance notes about this condition, e.g. reason for imposition or waiver details.

attributes.name: satisfaction_date
attributes.description: Date on which the condition was confirmed satisfied or breached. Null until evaluated.

attributes.name: source_form_number
attributes.description: Represents the source form number value associated with the condition entity in the coverage domain.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the originating system of record for this condition row.

attributes.name: source_system_condition_ref
attributes.description: Represents the source system condition ref value associated with the condition entity in the coverage domain.

attributes.name: text
attributes.description: Full policy language or manuscript wording of the condition as it appears in the contract.

attributes.name: type_code
attributes.description: Classifies the condition: WARRANTY, CONDITION_PRECEDENT, SPECIAL_CONDITION, REPORTING_REQUIREMENT, OTHER.

attributes.name: underwriter_notes
attributes.description: Represents the underwriter notes value associated with the condition entity in the coverage domain.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp of the most recent update to this condition record.

attributes.name: waiver_reason
attributes.description: Free-text reason recorded when condition_status is WAIVED; NULL otherwise.

attributes.name: waiver_reason_code
attributes.description: Represents the waiver reason code value associated with the condition entity in the coverage domain.

domains.name: premium
domains.description: Transactional ledger for all premium activity. Owns Premium Transaction (one row per financial transaction: Written, Earned, Unearned, Return) tied to Policy, Policy Term, Coverage, Insured Risk, and Accounting Period, with Charge, Tax, Fee, and
domains.references: NAIC SAP Premium Accounting / ACORD Premium Model

products.name: premium_transaction
products.description: Grain: one row per financial transaction. Each record represents a single premium financial transaction (Written, Earned, Unearned, Return) tied to Policy, Policy Term, Coverage, Insured Risk, and Accounting Period.
products.reference: ACORD Premium Transaction / SAP Written Premium Ledger

attributes.name: premium_transaction_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each premium financial movement record. Grain: one row per financial premium movement (Written, Earned, Unearned, Return). Primary key.

attributes.name: accounting_period_id
attributes.description: Reference to the accounting period in which this premium transaction is recognized for statutory and GAAP reporting purposes.
attributes.references: SAP/SSAP, US GAAP, IFRS 17, NAIC Annual Statement

attributes.name: agency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to producers.agency. Business justification: Agency-bill premium reconciliation requires attributing premium transactions directly to the billing agency for agency account statements and premium trust accounting.

attributes.name: calendar_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.calendar. Business justification: Premium transactions posted to accounting periods require calendar dimensions for fiscal/accident/policy year reporting.

attributes.name: claim_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to claims.claim. Business justification: Retrospectively-rated policies (workers comp, general liability) adjust premium based on actual claim experience during the policy term.

attributes.name: coverage_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific coverage line within the policy term to which this premium transaction is allocated. Enables per-coverage premium analytics.

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.currency. Business justification: Premium transactions record amounts in specific currencies. Multi-currency operations require proper FK for FX validation, conversion, and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: distribution_channel_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to producers.distribution_channel. Business justification: Distribution channel written premium volume reporting is a core P&C management report for growth and profitability analysis by channel.

attributes.name: geography_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to catastrophegeography.geography. Business justification: Premium transactions require geographic attribution for statutory state pages, territorial profitability analysis, regulatory reporting, and geographic concentration

attributes.name: household_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to party.household. Business justification: Personal lines household-level premium aggregation reports (total written premium per household, retention analysis, cross-sell scoring) require direct household linkage on premium

attributes.name: insured_risk_id
attributes.description: Reference to the insured risk or exposure unit (property, vehicle, driver) to which this premium transaction is allocated.

attributes.name: line_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to policy.line. Business justification: P&C premium is written and earned at the line-of-business level on a policy. Line-level written premium reports, loss ratio monitoring by LOB, and reinsurance cession calculations require linking

attributes.name: line_of_business_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.line_of_business. Business justification: Normalize lob_code string to FK reference to shared.line_of_business master data. Premium transaction currently stores lob_code as string; replacing with FK enables consistent LOB

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to riskexposure.location. Business justification: Commercial lines CAT accumulation reports and exposure management aggregate written/earned premium by insured location.

attributes.name: original_transaction_premium_transaction_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original premium transaction that this record reverses or corrects. Populated only when reversal_indicator is True. Supports audit trail.

attributes.name: policy_id
attributes.description: Reference to the policy under which this premium transaction was generated. Links the premium ledger entry to the master policy record.

attributes.name: policy_term_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific policy term (time-bounded period) to which this premium transaction belongs. Enables reconstruction of premium in force at any date.

attributes.name: policy_transaction_id
attributes.description: Reference to the policy transaction (New Business, Renewal, Endorsement, Cancellation, Reinstatement) that triggered this premium movement.

attributes.name: producers_producer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the producer (agent or broker) associated with this premium transaction for commission settlement and distribution channel reporting.

attributes.name: quote_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to coverage.quote. Business justification: Premium transactions originate from bound quotes; accounting audit trail requires quote reference for rate reconciliation, variance analysis between quoted and booked premium, and

attributes.name: rate_table_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to premium.rate_table. Business justification: Links each premium transaction to the versioned rate table used to price it, enabling audit of which rate filing, base rate, and algorithm produced the written premium.

attributes.name: territory_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to catastrophegeography.territory. Business justification: Written and earned premium must be aggregated by rating territory for state rate filings, loss ratio monitoring, and reinsurance bordereau reporting.

attributes.name: audit_basis
attributes.description: Exposure basis used for auditable policies (e.g., WC, CGL) to determine final earned premium: Payroll, Revenue, Units, Receipts, or None for non-auditable policies.

attributes.name: ceded_written_premium
attributes.description: Portion of gross written premium ceded to reinsurers under treaty or facultative agreements. Used for Schedule F and reinsurance bordereaux reporting.
attributes.references: SAP/SSAP No. 62, NAIC Schedule F, IFRS 17

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: Internal cost center or profit center code to which this premium transaction is allocated for management accounting and segment reporting purposes.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this premium transaction record was first created in the source system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: days_in_force
attributes.description: Number of days the coverage was in force during the accounting period for this premium transaction. Used in pro-rata earning and exposure calculations.

attributes.name: direct_billed_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this premium is billed directly to the policyholder (True) or through the producer/agency (False = agency billed). Drives billing workflow routing.

attributes.name: earned_premium
attributes.description: Portion of written premium recognized as earned for the accounting period based on pro-rata or other earning methodology. Core input to loss ratio (LR) calculation.
attributes.references: SAP/SSAP No. 53, NAIC Annual Statement Schedule P, IFRS 17

attributes.name: earning_method
attributes.description: Method used to recognize written premium as earned over the policy period: Pro-Rata (daily), 1/365, 1/24 (monthly), Flat (fully earned at inception), or Other.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this premium transaction takes effect for coverage and financial recognition purposes. Used to reconstruct premium in force at any given date.

attributes.name: endorsement_type
attributes.description: Type of endorsement premium adjustment: Additional (increase), Return (decrease/credit), Flat (no change), Audit (audit-based adjustment), or None for non-endorsement transactions.
attributes.references: Guidewire PolicyCenter, Duck Creek Policy, ACORD

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the premium coverage period ends for this transaction. Used for unearned premium (UEP) calculation and pro-rata earning.

attributes.name: exposure_amount
attributes.description: Quantitative exposure measure (e.g., payroll dollars, vehicle count, property TIV) underlying the premium calculation. Used for rate adequacy and actuarial analysis.

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: General ledger account code to which this premium transaction is posted in the statutory and GAAP accounting systems. Required for financial close and SOX compliance.
attributes.references: Oracle/SAP GL, SAP/SSAP, SOX, US GAAP

attributes.name: gross_written_premium
attributes.description: Total gross written premium amount for this transaction before cessions, taxes, fees, and commissions. Core ledger amount for statutory and GAAP reporting.
attributes.references: SAP/SSAP No. 53, NAIC Annual Statement Schedule P, IFRS 17

attributes.name: net_written_premium
attributes.description: Written premium net of reinsurance cessions. NWP = GWP minus ceded written premium. Used for net retention reporting and RBC calculations.
attributes.references: SAP/SSAP No. 53, NAIC Annual Statement, RBC

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments entered by underwriters, billing staff, or system processes to explain the reason for or context of this premium transaction.

attributes.name: payment_plan_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the installment or payment plan under which this premium is billed (e.g., Annual, Semi-Annual, Quarterly, Monthly, Pay-As-You-Go).

attributes.name: posted_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this premium transaction was posted to the general ledger and accounting system. Distinct from the business event date.

attributes.name: pro_rata_factor
attributes.description: Decimal factor (0.0 to 1.0) representing the proportion of the policy period elapsed as of the accounting period end date. Used to compute earned premium.

attributes.name: rate
attributes.description: The rate applied to the exposure base to calculate the premium for this transaction. Expressed per unit of exposure (e.g., per $100 payroll, per $1000 TIV).
attributes.references: ISO ERC, Earnix, State DOI rate filings

attributes.name: rate_effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the rate used for this premium transaction became effective. Required for rate adequacy monitoring and DOI rate filing compliance.
attributes.references: State DOI, ISO ERC, NAIC Model Laws

attributes.name: return_premium
attributes.description: Premium amount returned to the policyholder due to cancellation, mid-term endorsement reduction, or audit adjustment. Negative financial movement in the ledger.

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this premium transaction is a reversal of a previously posted transaction. True = reversal entry; False = original entry.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record that originated this premium transaction (e.g., PAS for PolicyCenter, BILLING for BillingCenter, RATING for rating engine).
attributes.references: Guidewire PolicyCenter, Duck Creek Policy, Internal Data Governance

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code where the risk is located or the policy is written. Required for state-level statutory reporting and DOI filings.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement, State DOI, ISO

attributes.name: transaction_date
attributes.description: The business event date on which this premium movement was generated or triggered (e.g., policy effective date, endorsement effective date, cancellation date).

attributes.name: transaction_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable identifier for this premium transaction as assigned by the Policy Administration System or billing system. Used in bordereaux and reconciliation.
attributes.references: ACORD, Guidewire PolicyCenter, Duck Creek Policy

attributes.name: transaction_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the premium transaction in the accounting ledger: Pending (awaiting posting), Posted (booked to GL), Reversed, Voided, or Error.

attributes.name: transaction_type
attributes.description: Classifies the premium movement. Allowed values: Written, Earned, Unearned, Return.
attributes.references: SAP/SSAP No. 53, NAIC Annual Statement, IFRS 17

attributes.name: unearned_premium
attributes.description: Portion of written premium not yet earned as of the accounting period end date. Represents the UEP reserve liability on the balance sheet.
attributes.references: SAP/SSAP No. 53, NAIC Annual Statement, IFRS 17

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this premium transaction record was last modified. Supports audit trail, change detection, and incremental data loading.

products.name: charge
products.description: Child of Premium Transaction. One row per charge component (base premium, surcharge, credit, minimum premium) within a transaction. Enables granular decomposition of gross written premium by rating element and LOB.
products.reference: ISO Rating Element / Guidewire PolicyCenter Charge

attributes.name: charge_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the charge component within a premium transaction.

attributes.name: accounting_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key to the accounting period in which this charge is recognized.

attributes.name: agency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to producers.agency. Business justification: Agency-bill reconciliation requires attributing charges directly to the billing agency. Agency bill statements aggregate charges by agency account; without a direct agency FK on charge

attributes.name: calendar_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.calendar. Business justification: Charges posted to accounting periods. FK enables period-based charge analysis, fiscal year reporting, and ensures charges align with calendar dimensions for financial statements.

attributes.name: cat_zone_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to catastrophegeography.cat_zone. Business justification: Wind, hail, and hurricane surcharges are rated and reported by cat zone. Underwriters and actuaries aggregate charge amounts by cat zone for concentration monitoring and

attributes.name: catastrophe_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to catastrophegeography.catastrophe_event. Business justification: Individual rating charges (wind surcharges, earthquake deductible buybacks) are event-specific for post-catastrophe pricing adjustments, experience rating, and

attributes.name: coverage_id
attributes.description: Foreign key to the coverage to which this charge applies, if coverage-specific.

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.currency. Business justification: Charges have amounts denominated in currency. FK enables currency validation, FX conversion for consolidated reporting, and ensures charge amounts reference valid active currencies for

attributes.name: driver_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to riskexposure.driver. Business justification: Personal auto point surcharges, defensive driving credits, and good-student discounts are booked as named charges attributed to a specific driver.

attributes.name: geography_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to catastrophegeography.geography. Business justification: Individual charges require geographic assignment for tax calculation, surplus lines allocation, territorial rating factors, and jurisdictional compliance.

attributes.name: insured_risk_id
attributes.description: Foreign key to the insured risk to which this charge applies, if risk-specific.

attributes.name: line_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to policy.line. Business justification: Surcharges, schedule credits/debits, and minimum premium charges apply at the policy line level in multi-line commercial policies.

attributes.name: line_of_business_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.line_of_business. Business justification: Charges apply to specific lines of business. FK enables LOB-specific charge analysis, regulatory reporting by line, and ensures charges reference valid active LOBs.

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to riskexposure.location. Business justification: Commercial multi-location policies apply location-specific surcharges (protection class charges, earthquake zone loadings, flood zone assessments).

attributes.name: peril_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to catastrophegeography.peril. Business justification: Individual charges (earthquake coverage, flood buyback, wind deductible) are peril-specific for pricing transparency, regulatory compliance, coverage verification, and claims

attributes.name: policy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key to the policy to which this charge applies.

attributes.name: policy_term_id
attributes.description: Foreign key to the policy term during which this charge is effective.

attributes.name: policy_transaction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to policy.policy_transaction. Business justification: Every charge (surcharge, credit, minimum premium) is generated by a specific policy transaction (endorsement, cancellation, renewal).

attributes.name: producers_producer_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to producers.producers_producer. Business justification: Producer commission statement generation and commissionable charge reconciliation require tracing each charge to the writing producer.

attributes.name: rate_table_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to premium.rate_table. Business justification: Links each charge component (base premium, surcharge, credit) to the specific rate table entry that produced it, supporting regulatory filing traceability and actuarial audit.

attributes.name: territory_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to catastrophegeography.territory. Business justification: Rating charges (base premium, increased limits factors, deductible credits) are computed from territory-specific rate relativities.

attributes.name: vehicle_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to riskexposure.vehicle. Business justification: Commercial auto policies apply per-vehicle charges such as safety equipment credits, anti-theft discounts, and radius-of-operation surcharges.

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: Monetary value of the charge component in the policy currency.

attributes.name: basis_amount
attributes.description: Base amount to which the charge rate is applied to derive the charge amount.

attributes.name: charge_category
attributes.description: High-level category of the charge: premium, fee, penalty, refund, or adjustment.

products.name: installment_plan
products.description: Installment schedule elected for a Policy Term with per-installment lines: number, due dates, billed/paid amounts, fees, and status. Feeds delinquency and cancellation-for-non-payment.
products.reference: Guidewire BillingCenter Payment Plan / Duck Creek Billing Schedule

attributes.name: installment_plan_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the installment plan. Primary key.

attributes.name: billing_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.account. Business justification: Installment plan is executed against a billing account. The installment_plan table tracks the elected payment schedule for a policy term, and that schedule is managed within the context of a

attributes.name: calendar_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.calendar. Business justification: Installment plans span accounting periods. FK enables period-based billing analysis, fiscal year receivables reporting, and ensures plans align with calendar dimensions for financial

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.currency. Business justification: Installment plan amounts denominated in currency. FK enables multi-currency billing, FX conversion for consolidated receivables reporting, and ensures plan amounts reference valid active

attributes.name: line_of_business_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.line_of_business. Business justification: Payment plans vary by line of business. FK enables LOB-specific billing analysis, payment plan management by line, and ensures plans reference valid LOBs for receivables reporting.

attributes.name: payment_id
attributes.description: Unique transaction identifier from the source billing system for this installment plan.

attributes.name: payment_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.payment_plan. Business justification: Installment plan is an instance of a payment plan template. The payment_plan table defines the master template (number of installments, down payment rules, fees, etc.), and

attributes.name: policy_id
attributes.description: Reference to the policy for which this installment plan was established.

attributes.name: policy_term_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific policy term covered by this installment plan.

attributes.name: policy_transaction_id
attributes.description: Reference to the policy transaction that triggered or modified this installment plan.

attributes.name: producers_producer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the producer or agent who sold the policy and established the installment plan.

attributes.name: amount_outstanding
attributes.description: Remaining unpaid balance on the installment plan, including overdue amounts.

attributes.name: amount_paid_to_date
attributes.description: Cumulative amount paid by the policyholder against this installment plan to date.

attributes.name: auto_pay_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether automatic payment is enabled for this installment plan.

attributes.name: billing_method
attributes.description: Method by which installments are billed: direct bill, agency bill, list bill, or account current.

attributes.name: cancellation_effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the policy will be cancelled if outstanding installments are not paid.

attributes.name: cancellation_notice_date
attributes.description: Date on which a notice of cancellation for non-payment was issued to the policyholder.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this installment plan record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: days_delinquent
attributes.description: Number of days the installment plan has been in delinquent status.

attributes.name: delinquency_date
attributes.description: Date on which the installment plan first became delinquent.

attributes.name: down_payment_amount
attributes.description: Initial down payment amount required at policy binding before installment schedule begins.

attributes.name: down_payment_date
attributes.description: Date on which the down payment was received or is due.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the installment plan becomes effective and binding.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the installment plan expires or is scheduled to be completed.

attributes.name: final_installment_due_date
attributes.description: Due date for the last scheduled installment payment under this plan.

attributes.name: first_installment_due_date
attributes.description: Due date for the first scheduled installment payment after the down payment.

attributes.name: grace_period_days
attributes.description: Number of days after the due date during which payment may be made without penalty or cancellation.

attributes.name: installment_fee_per_payment
attributes.description: Fee charged per installment payment to cover administrative costs of the payment plan.

attributes.name: installments_outstanding
attributes.description: Count of installments that remain unpaid or partially paid.

attributes.name: installments_paid
attributes.description: Count of installments that have been fully paid to date.

attributes.name: is_delinquent
attributes.description: Indicates whether the installment plan is currently delinquent due to missed or late payments.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this installment plan record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: late_fee_amount
attributes.description: Standard late fee charged per installment when payment is received after the grace period.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments regarding special arrangements, waivers, or exceptions for this installment plan.

attributes.name: number_of_installments
attributes.description: Total count of installment payments scheduled under this plan for the policy term.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Primary payment method elected for installment payments: EFT, credit card, check, cash, payroll deduction, or escrow.

attributes.name: plan_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the installment plan: active, completed, cancelled, suspended, or defaulted.

attributes.name: reinstatement_date
attributes.description: Date on which a previously cancelled or suspended installment plan was reinstated.

attributes.name: reinstatement_fee_amount
attributes.description: Fee charged to reinstate a cancelled or suspended installment plan.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the billing or policy administration system that created this installment plan record.

attributes.name: total_fees_amount
attributes.description: Total installment fees charged across all scheduled payments under this plan.

attributes.name: total_plan_amount
attributes.description: Total amount due under the installment plan, including premium and all fees.

attributes.name: total_premium_amount
attributes.description: Total premium amount to be collected across all installments under this plan.

products.name: account
products.description: Master billing account linking a policyholder or payee to invoicing and collections. One row per billing account. Tracks account type (direct bill, agency bill), status, payment method, and balance.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the billing account. Primary key.

attributes.name: billing_address_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to party.address. Business justification: Billing accounts require validated billing address distinct from policyholder address for invoice delivery, collections correspondence, and regulatory cancellation notices.

attributes.name: calendar_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.calendar. Business justification: Billing account next_invoice_date and effective_date must align to fiscal/accounting periods for period-close AR aging, NAIC premium receivable reporting, and billing cycle management.

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.currency. Business justification: Billing accounts maintain balances in specific currencies and require currency master data for balance calculations, aging reports, and multi-currency consolidation.

attributes.name: geography_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to catastrophegeography.geography. Business justification: Account billing geography determines tax jurisdiction codes, payment plan regulatory eligibility, escheatment rules, and state-specific billing regulations.

attributes.name: household_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to party.household. Business justification: Personal lines billing accounts are consolidated at the household level for multi-policy statements, household-level payment plans, and multi-policy discount eligibility.

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the party (policyholder or payee) who owns this billing account.

attributes.name: policy_id
attributes.description: Reference to the policy associated with this billing account.

attributes.name: producers_producer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the producer or agent responsible for this account, used for commission allocation and servicing.

attributes.name: submission_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to coverage.submission. Business justification: Billing accounts are often established during underwriting for quoted business to prepare payment collection infrastructure before binding.

attributes.name: account_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the billing account indicating whether it is active, suspended, closed, delinquent, pending activation, or cancelled.

attributes.name: account_type
attributes.description: Classification of billing account indicating who collects premium: direct bill (insurer bills policyholder), agency bill (producer collects), list bill, or account current.

attributes.name: auto_pay_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether automatic payment processing is enabled for this account. True means payments are automatically withdrawn on due date.

attributes.name: billing_contact_name
attributes.description: Name of the person or entity designated to receive billing communications and invoices for this account.

attributes.name: billing_email
attributes.description: Email address for delivery of electronic invoices, payment confirmations, and billing notices.

attributes.name: billing_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which invoices are generated for this account: monthly, quarterly, semi-annual, annual, or on-demand.

attributes.name: billing_method
attributes.description: Method by which the policyholder is billed: invoice, automatic payment, payroll deduction, escrow, or mortgagee bill.

attributes.name: billing_phone
attributes.description: Primary phone number for billing inquiries, payment reminders, and delinquency notifications.

attributes.name: cancellation_date
attributes.description: Date the billing account was cancelled, either due to policy cancellation, non-payment, or policyholder request.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Business reason for account cancellation: non-payment, policy cancellation, policyholder request, fraud, or other. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: non_payment|policy_cancelled|policyholder_request|fraud|underwriting|rewrite|duplicate|other — promote to reference

attributes.name: commission_payable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether producer commission is payable on premium collected through this account. False for direct accounts with no producer involvement.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time this billing account record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: credit_balance
attributes.description: Total credit amount available on the account from overpayments, return premiums, or cancellations. Positive value indicates credit owed to policyholder.

attributes.name: current_balance
attributes.description: Current outstanding balance on the account, representing total amount owed by the policyholder. Positive indicates amount due; negative indicates credit.

attributes.name: days_past_due
attributes.description: Number of days the oldest unpaid invoice on this account is overdue. Zero indicates account is current.

attributes.name: delinquency_status
attributes.description: Classification of account delinquency based on days past due: current, 1-30 days, 31-60 days, 61-90 days, over 90 days, or in collections.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date the billing account became active and began accepting charges and payments.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date the billing account is scheduled to close or expire, typically aligned with policy expiration or account closure.

attributes.name: grace_period_days
attributes.description: Number of days after payment due date before policy cancellation for non-payment is initiated, as required by state regulation.

attributes.name: last_payment_amount
attributes.description: Monetary amount of the most recent payment received on this account.

attributes.name: last_payment_date
attributes.description: Date the most recent payment was received and posted to this account.

attributes.name: next_invoice_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next invoice to be generated for this account based on billing frequency and payment plan.

attributes.name: next_payment_due_date
attributes.description: Date by which the next payment is due to avoid delinquency or late fees.

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Externally visible unique account number assigned to the billing account for customer reference and payment processing.

attributes.name: outstanding_fees
attributes.description: Total unpaid fees currently due on this account, including installment fees, late fees, and service charges.

attributes.name: outstanding_premium
attributes.description: Total unpaid premium amount currently due on this account, excluding fees, taxes, and other charges.

attributes.name: outstanding_taxes
attributes.description: Total unpaid taxes currently due on this account, including premium taxes, surplus lines taxes, and stamping fees.

attributes.name: paperless_billing_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the policyholder has opted for electronic delivery of invoices and billing statements instead of paper mail.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Preferred payment instrument for this account: credit card, debit card, ACH (Automated Clearing House), check, wire transfer, or cash.

attributes.name: payment_plan_type
attributes.description: Installment plan structure for premium payments: full pay, monthly, quarterly, semi-annual, or custom installment schedule.

attributes.name: unapplied_cash
attributes.description: Amount of cash received but not yet applied to specific invoices or charges, held in suspense pending allocation.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time this billing account record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: write_off_amount
attributes.description: Total amount written off as uncollectible on this account due to bankruptcy, insolvency, or collection failure.

attributes.name: write_off_date
attributes.description: Date the uncollectible balance was written off and removed from accounts receivable.

products.name: invoice
products.description: Billing document issued to a policyholder or agency for premium charges, fees, and taxes due. One row per invoice. Grain: one invoice per billing cycle per billing account. Tracks due date, amount billed, and status.
products.reference: Guidewire BillingCenter Invoice / ACORD Billing Statement

attributes.name: invoice_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the invoice. Primary key.

attributes.name: agency_id
attributes.description: Reference to the agency associated with this invoice for agency bill scenarios.

attributes.name: bill_to_party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the party to whom this invoice is addressed, may differ from policyholder.

attributes.name: billing_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the billing account that owns this invoice.

attributes.name: calendar_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.calendar. Business justification: Invoice GL posting date and billing period must align to fiscal/accounting calendar periods for NAIC statutory reporting, period-close AR reconciliation, and premium written/earned

attributes.name: claim_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to claims.claim. Business justification: Invoices bill claim-related charges: deductible collection from insureds, salvage recovery billing, subrogation reimbursement invoicing.

attributes.name: claim_payment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to claimfinancials.claim_payment. Business justification: Deductible recovery billing: when a claim payment is made, an invoice is generated to recover the insured's deductible.

attributes.name: commission_schedule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to producers.commission_schedule. Business justification: Commission audit trail: invoice.commission_amount is computed from a commission_schedule.

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.currency. Business justification: Invoices are primary financial documents requiring full currency master data for multi-currency operations: exchange rates, rounding rules, display formats, and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: geography_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to catastrophegeography.geography. Business justification: Invoice-level geography enables jurisdiction-specific tax calculation (state premium tax, municipal fees, surplus lines tax), regulatory reporting by domicile, and multi-state

attributes.name: line_of_business_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.line_of_business. Business justification: Invoices require LOB segmentation for financial reporting, regulatory filings (Schedule P, statutory annual statements), and business analytics.

attributes.name: payment_plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the payment plan or installment schedule associated with this invoice.

attributes.name: policy_id
attributes.description: Reference to the policy for which this invoice was generated.

attributes.name: policy_term_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific policy term covered by this invoice.

attributes.name: policy_transaction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to policy.policy_transaction. Business justification: P&C invoices are generated by policy transactions (new business, endorsement, renewal, cancellation).

attributes.name: policyholder_id
attributes.description: Reference to the party responsible for payment of this invoice.

attributes.name: producers_producer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the producer or agent associated with this invoice for commission purposes.

attributes.name: ri_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reinsurance.ri_agreement. Business justification: Bordereaux and ceded-premium settlement invoices are issued under a specific reinsurance agreement.

attributes.name: risk_inspection_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to riskexposure.risk_inspection. Business justification: Inspection fees are billed as separate invoices tied to a specific risk inspection order.

attributes.name: amount_paid
attributes.description: Total amount paid against this invoice to date.

attributes.name: billing_method
attributes.description: Method by which the invoice is billed: direct to policyholder or through agency.

attributes.name: billing_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the coverage or billing period represented by this invoice.

attributes.name: billing_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the coverage or billing period represented by this invoice.

attributes.name: cancellation_notice_date
attributes.description: Date on which a cancellation notice was sent due to non-payment of this invoice.

attributes.name: commission_amount
attributes.description: Total commission payable to the producer or agency on this invoice.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this invoice record was first created in the billing system.

attributes.name: delinquency_status
attributes.description: Current delinquency status of this invoice for collections management.

attributes.name: invoice_description
attributes.description: Free-text description or memo providing additional context about this invoice.

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: Date by which payment is due for this invoice.

attributes.name: fee_amount
attributes.description: Total fees and surcharges included in this invoice.

attributes.name: gl_posting_date
attributes.description: Date on which this invoice was posted to the general ledger for accounting purposes.

attributes.name: installment_number
attributes.description: Sequence number of this invoice within a multi-installment payment plan.

attributes.name: invoice_date
attributes.description: Date the invoice was issued to the policyholder or agency.

attributes.name: invoice_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the invoice in the billing workflow. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|issued|billed|paid|partially_paid|overdue|cancelled|written_off — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: invoice_type
attributes.description: Type of invoice based on the underlying policy transaction or billing event. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: new_business|renewal|endorsement|cancellation|reinstatement|audit|installment|commission — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this invoice record was last updated in the billing system.

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Externally visible unique invoice number assigned by the billing system.

attributes.name: outstanding_balance
attributes.description: Remaining unpaid balance on this invoice.

attributes.name: paid_date
attributes.description: Date on which this invoice was fully paid.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Preferred or expected payment method for this invoice. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: check|ach|credit_card|debit_card|wire_transfer|cash|payroll_deduction — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: premium_amount
attributes.description: Total premium charges included in this invoice before taxes and fees.

attributes.name: reversal_date
attributes.description: Date on which this invoice was reversed or voided.

attributes.name: reversal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this invoice has been reversed or voided.

attributes.name: reversal_reason
attributes.description: Business reason or code explaining why this invoice was reversed.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total tax charges included in this invoice.

attributes.name: total_amount_due
attributes.description: Total amount due on this invoice including premium, taxes, and fees.

attributes.name: total_installments
attributes.description: Total number of installments in the payment plan for this policy term.

attributes.name: write_off_reason
attributes.description: Business reason or code explaining why this invoice balance was written off.

attributes.name: written_off_date
attributes.description: Date on which the outstanding balance of this invoice was written off as uncollectible.

products.name: invoice_item
products.description: Line-level detail on an invoice representing a single charge, tax, fee, or commission amount. One row per line item per invoice. Links to premium charge, coverage, and policy term for reconciliation.

attributes.name: invoice_item_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the invoice item. Primary key.

attributes.name: accounting_period_id
attributes.description: Reference to the accounting period this item is recognized in for financial reporting and statutory filings.

attributes.name: cat_zone_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to catastrophegeography.cat_zone. Business justification: Wind pool assessments, coastal surcharges, and cat-zone-specific fees appear as invoice line items requiring cat zone attribution.

attributes.name: catastrophe_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to catastrophegeography.catastrophe_event. Business justification: Cat assessment fees, FHCF surcharges, and cat-specific premium endorsements appear as invoice line items tied to specific cat events.

attributes.name: cession_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reinsurance.cession. Business justification: Invoice items for ceded policies must track which cession applies to calculate net premium due after reinsurance credit.

attributes.name: charge_id
attributes.description: Reference to the premium charge record this item bills. Null for taxes, fees, or commissions.

attributes.name: claim_expense_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to claimfinancials.claim_expense. Business justification: LAE expense billing reconciliation: vendor invoices for DCC/LAE expenses (legal, medical, expert) generate invoice line items referencing the specific claim_expense record

attributes.name: claim_payment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to claimfinancials.claim_payment. Business justification: Line-level deductible billing reconciliation: each invoice line for a deductible charge references the specific claim payment that generated it, enabling precise cash

attributes.name: coverage_id
attributes.description: Reference to the coverage this item charges for. Null for policy-level fees or taxes.

attributes.name: driver_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to riskexposure.driver. Business justification: Driver-specific billing line items — SR-22 filing fees, driver surcharges, and DUI-related premium loads — must reference the specific driver.

attributes.name: invoice_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent invoice header. Links this line item to its containing invoice.

attributes.name: payment_plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the payment plan this item is billed under. Null for full-pay or direct-bill policies.

attributes.name: policy_id
attributes.description: Reference to the policy this invoice item relates to. Enables reconciliation to policy contract.

attributes.name: policy_term_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific policy term period this charge applies to. Supports effective dating.

attributes.name: policy_transaction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to policy.policy_transaction. Business justification: Invoice line items in P&C are generated by policy transactions (premium changes, endorsements, cancellations).

attributes.name: producers_producer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the producer or agent earning the commission. Populated only when item_type is commission.

attributes.name: property_risk_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to riskexposure.property_risk. Business justification: Commercial property premium allocation requires billing line items tied to specific property risks.

attributes.name: reinsurance_recovery_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to claimfinancials.reinsurance_recovery. Business justification: Line-level reinsurance recovery billing: invoice line items for ceded loss and LAE reference specific reinsurance_recovery records, enabling per-line reconciliation of

attributes.name: reversed_item_invoice_item_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original invoice item this item reverses. Populated only when reversal_flag is true.

attributes.name: ri_claim_cession_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reinsurance.ri_claim_cession. Business justification: Invoice line items for reinsurance loss recovery billings reference the specific ri_claim_cession being billed.

attributes.name: riskexposure_insured_risk_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to riskexposure.insured_risk. Business justification: Commercial lines billing often requires risk-level premium detail for schedule-rated policies with multiple locations/buildings.

attributes.name: tax_levy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to premium.tax_levy. Business justification: Invoice items for taxes must reference the specific tax_levy record that calculated the tax amount.

attributes.name: vehicle_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to riskexposure.vehicle. Business justification: Auto insurance billing allocates premium line items per vehicle (VIN-level). Vehicle-specific surcharges, endorsement fees, and per-vehicle installment schedules require this FK.

attributes.name: billing_method
attributes.description: Method by which this item is billed: direct to policyholder, agency bill, list bill, or account current.

attributes.name: commission_rate
attributes.description: Commission rate applied to calculate the commission amount. Expressed as a decimal. Populated only when item_type is commission.

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: User identifier or system process that created this invoice item record. Supports audit and compliance.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this invoice item record was first created in the billing system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the item amount. Typically USD for US-domiciled insurers.

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: Date payment for this invoice item is due from the policyholder. Inherited from invoice header but may vary by item.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date this invoice item becomes effective. Aligns with the policy transaction or coverage effective date.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date this invoice item expires. Aligns with the policy term or coverage expiration date.

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: General ledger account code this item posts to. Enables financial statement reconciliation and statutory reporting.

attributes.name: installment_number
attributes.description: Installment sequence number if this item is part of an installment payment plan. Null for full-pay policies.

attributes.name: item_amount
attributes.description: Monetary amount of this invoice line item in the invoice currency. Positive for charges, negative for credits or refunds.

attributes.name: item_category
attributes.description: Further categorization of the item within its type. For premium: written, earned, unearned, return. For fees: installment, surcharge, penalty. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: written|earned|unearned|return|installment|surcharge|penalty — 7 candidates stripped

attributes.name: item_code
attributes.description: Internal billing code or accounting code for the item type. Used for general ledger posting and reporting.

attributes.name: item_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the invoice item displayed to the policyholder. Explains what is being charged.

attributes.name: item_type
attributes.description: Classification of the invoice line item indicating what is being billed: premium charge, tax, fee, commission, adjustment, or refund.

attributes.name: line_number
attributes.description: Sequential line number within the invoice for ordering and display purposes.

attributes.name: outstanding_amount
attributes.description: Remaining unpaid balance for this invoice item. Calculated as item_amount minus paid_amount.

attributes.name: paid_amount
attributes.description: Amount of this invoice item that has been paid by the policyholder. Updated as payments are applied.

attributes.name: proration_factor
attributes.description: Decimal factor applied to calculate prorated premium for mid-term endorsements or cancellations.

attributes.name: proration_method
attributes.description: Method used to prorate premium for mid-term changes. Daily, monthly, short-rate, pro-rata, or full-term.

attributes.name: reversal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this invoice item reverses a prior item due to cancellation, endorsement, or correction. True if reversal, false otherwise.

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction
attributes.description: State, county, or municipal jurisdiction imposing the tax. Populated only when item_type is tax.
attributes.references: State Department of Insurance Tax Regulations

attributes.name: tax_rate
attributes.description: Tax rate applied to calculate the tax amount. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.06 for 6%). Populated only when item_type is tax.

attributes.name: taxable_base_amount
attributes.description: Base premium amount the tax is calculated on. Populated only when item_type is tax.

attributes.name: transaction_date
attributes.description: Date the underlying premium or billing transaction occurred that generated this invoice item.

attributes.name: updated_by_user
attributes.description: User identifier or system process that last modified this invoice item record. Supports audit and compliance.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this invoice item record was last modified. Supports audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: waived_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this fee or charge was waived by underwriting or management approval. True if waived, false otherwise.

attributes.name: waiver_reason
attributes.description: Business reason the fee or charge was waived. Populated only when waived_flag is true.

attributes.name: write_off_amount
attributes.description: Amount of this invoice item written off as uncollectible. Reduces outstanding balance without payment.

products.name: payment
products.description: Record of a payment received from a policyholder, agency, or third party against a billing account. One row per payment transaction. Captures payment method, amount, receipt date, and application status.

attributes.name: payment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the payment transaction. Primary key.

attributes.name: agency_id
attributes.description: Reference to the agency associated with this payment, if applicable.

attributes.name: billing_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the billing account against which this payment is applied.
attributes.references: Billing System (Guidewire BillingCenter or Duck Creek Billing)

attributes.name: calendar_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.calendar. Business justification: Payment receipt and GL posting dates must tie to fiscal/accounting periods for cash-basis premium reporting, NAIC Schedule T, and period-close cash reconciliation.

attributes.name: commission_statement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to producers.commission_statement. Business justification: Agency-bill remittance reconciliation: agencies remit premium net of commission, and the payment corresponds to a specific commission_statement.

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.currency. Business justification: Payments received in multiple currencies require currency master data for foreign exchange processing, bank reconciliation, and treasury operations.

attributes.name: invoice_id
attributes.description: Reference to the invoice this payment is applied against, if applicable.

attributes.name: payer_party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the party (person or organization) who made the payment.

attributes.name: payment_method_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.payment_method. Business justification: payment.method (STRING) is a denormalized copy of the payment instrument type that is authoritatively stored in payment_method.

attributes.name: payment_plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the payment plan or installment schedule this payment is part of, if applicable.

attributes.name: policy_id
attributes.description: Reference to the policy associated with this payment.

attributes.name: policy_term_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to policy.term. Business justification: In P&C, premium payments must be allocated to specific policy terms for earned/unearned premium accounting, reinsurance treaty settlement, and policy year loss ratio reporting.

attributes.name: producers_producer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the producer or agent associated with this payment, if applicable.

products.name: payment_application
products.description: Links a payment to one or more invoices or invoice items, and holds all unapplied/suspense cash pending identification of the correct account or invoice. One row per application or suspense holding.

attributes.name: payment_application_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the payment application record. Primary key.

attributes.name: accounting_period_id
attributes.description: Reference to the accounting period in which this payment application was recognized for financial reporting.

attributes.name: billing_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the billing account for which this payment application or suspense holding is recorded.

attributes.name: calendar_id

attributes.name: claim_payment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to claimfinancials.claim_payment. Business justification: Deductible cash application: when an insured pays their deductible, the payment application offsets a specific claim payment.

attributes.name: coverage_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to coverage.coverage. Business justification: Payment applications allocate received funds to specific coverages when policies have multiple coverage parts with separate billing.

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.currency. Business justification: payment_application carries denormalized currency_code. Multi-currency cash application and GL reconciliation require a proper FK to currency for FX reporting and period-close.

attributes.name: installment_schedule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.installment_schedule. Business justification: A payment_application records how a payment is allocated. Linking it to the specific installment_schedule row being satisfied closes the reconciliation loop: the scheduled

attributes.name: invoice_id
attributes.description: Reference to the invoice to which this payment is applied. Null if unapplied or suspense.

attributes.name: invoice_item_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific invoice line item to which this payment is applied. Null if applied at invoice level or unapplied.

attributes.name: payment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the payment transaction being applied or held in suspense.

attributes.name: policy_id
attributes.description: Reference to the policy associated with this payment application. Null if payment is not policy-specific.

attributes.name: policy_term_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to policy.term. Business justification: Payment applications allocate cash to specific policy terms for earned premium recognition, unearned premium reserve management, and reinsurance accounting.

attributes.name: reversed_application_payment_application_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original payment application record that this reversal is correcting. Null if not a reversal.

attributes.name: ri_recovery_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reinsurance.ri_recovery. Business justification: When a reinsurer remits a recovery payment, the cash application team applies it via payment_application.

attributes.name: allocation_priority
attributes.description: Numeric priority order for applying this payment when multiple invoices or items are eligible. Lower numbers indicate higher priority.

attributes.name: allocation_rule_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the business rule used to allocate this payment across invoices or items.

attributes.name: application_date
attributes.description: Date on which the payment was applied to the invoice or moved to suspense.

attributes.name: application_method
attributes.description: Method by which the payment was applied: automatic matching, manual user action, system rule, batch process, or override.

attributes.name: application_number
attributes.description: Business-readable identifier for this payment application transaction.

attributes.name: application_reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the reason for the application, unapplied status, or suspense holding.

attributes.name: application_reason_description
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of why the payment was applied, held unapplied, or placed in suspense.

attributes.name: application_status
attributes.description: Current status of the payment application in the billing lifecycle.

attributes.name: application_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the payment application was recorded in the billing system.

attributes.name: application_type
attributes.description: Type of payment application: applied to invoice, held as unapplied cash, held in suspense, reversal of prior application, or adjustment.

attributes.name: applied_amount
