attributes.name: agreement_type
attributes.description: Type of reinsurance agreement: Quota Share (QS), Excess of Loss (XOL), Stop Loss (SL), Catastrophe XL (CAT XL), or Facultative (FAC). Determines cession and recovery mechanics.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; SAP SSAP No. 62R; IFRS 17

attributes.name: brokerage_commission_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of ceded premium payable to the reinsurance broker for placing this participant's line. Applied to the participant's share of written premium.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; SAP SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: ceding_commission_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of ceded premium returned to the cedant by this reinsurer as a ceding commission, covering acquisition and overhead costs. Applicable primarily to QS treaties.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F; IFRS 17

attributes.name: cession_share_pct
attributes.description: Effective share of each cession allocated to this participant, derived from signed line and order hereon. Used to compute this reinsurer's portion of premium and loss.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F; IFRS 17

attributes.name: commutation_amount
attributes.description: Lump-sum amount agreed upon in the commutation to settle all outstanding reserves and future obligations for this reinsurer's participation share.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F; IFRS 17

attributes.name: commutation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the commutation agreement was executed, extinguishing all future obligations between the cedant and this reinsurer under this participation.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: commutation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this participation has been commuted, meaning all outstanding obligations have been settled by a lump-sum payment and the agreement extinguished.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F; IFRS 17

attributes.name: cut_through_clause_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a cut-through endorsement exists allowing the cedant's policyholders to claim directly against this reinsurer in the event of the cedant's insolvency.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the reinsurer's participation in the agreement becomes binding and cessions may be allocated to this participant.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; IFRS 17; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the reinsurer's participation ends. Null for open-ended participations. Used to determine in-force panel at any given date.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; IFRS 17; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: funds_withheld_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the cedant withholds ceded premium from this reinsurer under a funds-withheld arrangement, used as collateral for unauthorized reinsurers.
attributes.references: NAIC Credit for Reinsurance Model Law; SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: insolvency_clause_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the standard insolvency clause is included, requiring the reinsurer to pay claims even if the cedant becomes insolvent, per NAIC model law requirements.
attributes.references: NAIC Credit for Reinsurance Model Law; SAP SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: lc_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of the letter of credit posted by this reinsurer as collateral. Required for Schedule F credit for reinsurance calculations for unauthorized reinsurers.
attributes.references: NAIC Credit for Reinsurance Model Law; NAIC Schedule F; SAP SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: lc_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this reinsurer is required to post a letter of credit as collateral for credit for reinsurance purposes under state regulation.
attributes.references: NAIC Credit for Reinsurance Model Law; NAIC Schedule F; SAP SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: offset_clause_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the participation agreement includes an offset clause allowing mutual debts between cedant and reinsurer to be netted in settlement.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: order_hereon_pct
attributes.description: The cedant's order percentage representing the total share of risk placed with the reinsurance market. Used to scale signed and written lines to the actual ceded amount.
attributes.references: Lloyd's Market Association (LMA); NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: participant_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique identifier assigned by the reinsurance management system to this participation line, used in bordereaux and Schedule F reporting.

attributes.name: participant_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the reinsurer's participation in the agreement. Controls whether cessions and recoveries can be posted against this participant.

attributes.name: participation_type
attributes.description: Classifies the reinsurer's role in the panel: leader sets terms, followers subscribe, sole reinsurer takes 100%. Drives bordereaux and settlement logic.
attributes.references: ACORD data standards; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: placement_date
attributes.description: Date on which the reinsurer's line was formally placed and agreed, which may precede the participation effective date. Used for audit trail and contract management.

attributes.name: profit_commission_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of underwriting profit returned to the cedant by this reinsurer under a profit commission clause. Calculated after losses and expenses against this participant's share.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: retrocession_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this participation is part of a retrocession arrangement where the reinsurer is itself ceding risk onward to a retrocessionaire.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: rol_pct
attributes.description: Rate on Line expressed as a percentage of the limit, representing the reinsurance premium as a proportion of the coverage limit for this participant's share. Key XOL pricing metric.
attributes.references: Lloyd's Market Association (LMA); NAIC Schedule F; SAP SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: settlement_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which premium and loss accounts are settled between the cedant and this reinsurer. Drives bordereaux generation and cash settlement scheduling.
attributes.references: Sapiens ReinsurancePro; NAIC Schedule F; SAP SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: signed_line_pct
attributes.description: The percentage of the agreement's risk that the reinsurer has formally signed and committed to. Signed lines across all participants must sum to 100% for a fully placed agreement.
attributes.references: Lloyd's Market Association (LMA); NAIC Schedule F; SAP SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: signing_date
attributes.description: Date on which the reinsurer formally signed the slip or contract, confirming their committed signed line percentage. Distinct from placement date.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the originating reinsurance management system record (e.g., Sapiens ReinsurancePro participant ID) for lineage and reconciliation purposes.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date on which the reinsurer's participation was terminated prior to the scheduled expiration date, such as due to insolvency, commutation, or mutual agreement.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: Reason code for early termination of the reinsurer's participation. Used in commutation accounting and Schedule F disclosures.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; SAP SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: trust_fund_amount
attributes.description: Amount held in a reinsurance trust fund by this reinsurer as an alternative collateral mechanism for credit for reinsurance under NAIC model law.
attributes.references: NAIC Credit for Reinsurance Model Law; NAIC Schedule F; SAP SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: written_line_pct
attributes.description: The percentage of the agreement initially offered to and accepted by the reinsurer before signing-down. May differ from signed line when the placement is oversubscribed.
attributes.references: Lloyd's Market Association (LMA); NAIC Schedule F

products.name: cession
products.description: Records risk transfer of a policy term to a treaty layer or FAC. Grain: one row per policy term per treaty layer (or FAC). Direction flag (outward/retro) distinguishes cession from retrocession.

attributes.name: cession_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each cession record. One row per policy term per treaty layer or facultative agreement. Primary key of the cession table.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; SAP SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: accounting_period_id
attributes.description: Reference to the accounting period in which this cession is booked for statutory and GAAP financial reporting purposes.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Annual Statement Schedule F

attributes.name: calendar_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.calendar. Business justification: Cession records must align to NAIC reporting quarters and SAP/GAAP fiscal periods for bordereaux aggregation and Schedule F filing.

attributes.name: cat_zone_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to catastrophegeography.cat_zone. Business justification: Reinsurance cessions must be aggregated by catastrophe zone for bordereaux reporting, accumulation limit monitoring, and Schedule F regulatory filings.

attributes.name: catastrophe_event_id
attributes.description: Reference to the catastrophe event associated with this cession when is_catastrophe_cession is true. Links to the catastrophe event for PML and AAL aggregation.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; RMS RiskLink; Verisk AIR Touchstone

attributes.name: coverage_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to coverage.coverage. Business justification: Cessions record the actual transfer of risk to reinsurers. Premium and claim cessions must trace to the specific coverage being ceded for accurate bordereaux reporting, treaty allocation

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.currency. Business justification: Cession accounting requires currency master for exchange rate application, multi-currency premium and loss aggregation, and statutory reporting in reporting currency.

attributes.name: fac_agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the facultative reinsurance agreement if this is a FAC cession. Null for treaty cessions.

attributes.name: line_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to policy.line. Business justification: Reinsurance cessions are allocated by LOB line within a policy term. Linking cession to the policy line record enables LOB-level bordereaux production, Schedule F reporting by line, and

attributes.name: line_of_business_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.line_of_business. Business justification: Cession accounting and bordereaux submission require LOB master for consistent line classification, treaty applicability rules, and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: peril_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to catastrophegeography.peril. Business justification: Cessions must identify the triggering peril for treaty allocation, bordereaux reporting, Schedule F classification, and reinsurer accounting.

attributes.name: policy_term_id
attributes.description: Reference to the policy term being ceded. Links the cession to the specific time-bounded policy period in force at the time of cession.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; Guidewire PolicyCenter Cession module

attributes.name: policy_transaction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to policy.policy_transaction. Business justification: Mid-term endorsements, cancellations, and reinstatements change subject premium and trigger cession adjustments.

attributes.name: quote_coverage_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to coverage.quote_coverage. Business justification: Cessions must reconcile back to the original quoted coverage that was bound, enabling auditors and actuaries to trace ceded premium from quote through bind to cession.

attributes.name: reinsurer_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reinsurance.reinsurer. Business justification: reinsurance_cession has reinsurer_party_id pointing to the cross-domain party table but no FK to the in-domain reinsurer master record.

attributes.name: reinsurer_party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the reinsurer party accepting this cession. Supports multi-reinsurer panels where each reinsurer has a separate cession row.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; SAP SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: ri_agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent reinsurance agreement (treaty or facultative) under which this cession is placed.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: ri_participant_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reinsurance.ri_participant. Business justification: A cession is made to a specific reinsurer's participation share (signed line %, ceding commission %, settlement terms).

attributes.name: riskexposure_insured_risk_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to riskexposure.insured_risk. Business justification: Cessions represent the actual transfer of specific risk exposure to reinsurers. Exposure management and catastrophe modeling require linking cessions to underlying insured risks to

attributes.name: treaty_layer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific treaty layer (e.g., first excess layer, second excess layer) within the reinsurance agreement to which this cession attaches.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: accident_year
attributes.description: Accident Year (AY) associated with losses ceded under this cession. Used for loss development triangles and IBNR reserving on ceded basis.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P; SAP SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: agreement_type
attributes.description: Classifies the cession as treaty-based (automatic, per agreed terms) or facultative (individually negotiated per risk).

attributes.name: attachment_point
attributes.description: Dollar threshold at which the reinsurer's liability begins under an XOL or CAT XL treaty. Equivalent to the cedant's retention for excess layers.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; ISO XOL treaty standards

attributes.name: booking_date
attributes.description: Date on which this cession was recorded in the Reinsurance Management System and booked to the general ledger for statutory reporting.

attributes.name: bordereaux_period
attributes.description: Reporting period (YYYY-MM or YYYY-Q#) for which this cession is included in the reinsurance bordereaux submission to the reinsurer.
attributes.references: ACORD 790; NAIC Schedule F; Sapiens ReinsurancePro Bordereaux module

attributes.name: ceded_case_reserve
attributes.description: Reinsurer's share of the case reserve for known reported losses ceded under this cession. Used for ceded reserve reporting on Schedule F.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F; NAIC Schedule P

attributes.name: ceded_earned_premium
attributes.description: Portion of the ceded premium that has been earned as of the reporting date, based on the pro-rata exposure period elapsed.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F; IFRS 17

attributes.name: ceded_gwp
attributes.description: Gross Written Premium (GWP) ceded to the reinsurer for this policy term. Represents the cedant's cost of reinsurance before ceding commission.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Annual Statement Schedule F

attributes.name: ceded_ibnr_reserve
attributes.business_glossary_term: Ceded Incurred But Not Reported Reserve (IBNR)
attributes.description: Reinsurer's share of the IBNR reserve for losses incurred but not yet reported under this cession. Required for ceded IBNR disclosure on Schedule F.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F; NAIC Schedule P

tag_set.value: Ceded Incurred But Not Reported Reserve (IBNR)

attributes.name: ceded_limit
attributes.description: Maximum reinsurer liability under this cession. For XOL treaties, this is the layer limit; for QS, it is the proportional share of the policy limit.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: ceded_tiv
attributes.description: Total Insured Value (TIV) transferred to the reinsurer under this cession. Represents the gross exposure ceded for property lines.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F; ISO property rating

attributes.name: ceded_unearned_premium
attributes.description: Portion of the ceded premium not yet earned as of the reporting date. Represents the reinsurer's liability for the unexpired risk period.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Annual Statement Schedule F

attributes.name: ceding_commission_amount
attributes.description: Commission paid by the reinsurer to the cedant to offset acquisition and administrative costs. Reduces the net cost of reinsurance.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: ceding_commission_pct
attributes.description: Ceding commission expressed as a percentage of ceded written premium. Used to calculate the ceding commission amount for QS treaties.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: collateral_amount
attributes.description: Amount of collateral (letters of credit, trust funds) posted by an unauthorized reinsurer to secure their obligations under this cession.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; NAIC Model Credit for Reinsurance Law

attributes.name: collateral_type
attributes.description: Type of collateral instrument posted by the reinsurer to secure obligations. Required for unauthorized reinsurers per NAIC credit for reinsurance rules.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; NAIC Model Credit for Reinsurance Law

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this cession record was first created in the Reinsurance Management System. Used for audit trail and data lineage.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: direction
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is an outward cession (cedant to reinsurer) or a retrocession (reinsurer ceding further). Distinguishes primary cession from retro.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which this cession becomes effective and the reinsurer assumes the ceded risk. Aligns with the policy term effective date for automatic treaty cessions.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: exhaustion_point
attributes.description: Dollar amount at which the reinsurer's layer is fully exhausted (attachment point plus ceded limit). Defines the upper boundary of the reinsurer's liability.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; ISO XOL treaty standards

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the cession expires and the reinsurer's liability ceases. Typically aligns with the policy term expiration date.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: funds_held_amount
attributes.description: Amount of reinsurance premium held by the cedant as funds held under the reinsurance agreement, rather than remitted to the reinsurer.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: is_catastrophe_cession
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cession is associated with a catastrophe event (CAT XL treaty). Flags cessions for CAT PML aggregation and catastrophe bordereaux reporting.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; RMS RiskLink CAT modeling

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for this cession, used in bordereaux reporting and reinsurer correspondence. Assigned by the Reinsurance Management System.

attributes.name: policy_year
attributes.description: Policy Year (PY) in which the ceded policy term incepted. Used for actuarial loss development, Schedule P, and reinsurance year-of-account reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P; SAP SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: rate_on_line
attributes.description: Rate on Line (ROL) expressed as a percentage of the ceded limit. Key pricing metric for XOL and CAT XL layers; equals ceded premium divided by ceded limit.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; ISO reinsurance pricing standards

attributes.name: reinsurance_cession_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the cession record within the reinsurance management workflow.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; Sapiens ReinsurancePro Cession module

attributes.name: reinsurer_authorization_status
attributes.description: NAIC authorization classification of the assuming reinsurer: authorized, accredited, certified, unauthorized, or reciprocal. Drives collateral and credit requirements.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; NAIC Model Credit for Reinsurance Law

attributes.name: reinsurer_domicile_country
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the reinsurer's domicile. Determines whether the reinsurer is authorized, accredited, or unauthorized under NAIC Schedule F.

attributes.name: reinsurer_naic_code
attributes.description: Five-digit NAIC company code of the assuming reinsurer. Required for NAIC Schedule F statutory reporting and reinsurer credit risk assessment.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; NAIC Company Code Registry

attributes.name: retention_amount
attributes.description: Amount retained by the cedant (Self-Insured Retention / SIR) before the reinsurer's liability attaches. Attachment point for XOL; retained share for QS.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: share_pct
attributes.description: Proportional share (as a percentage) ceded to the reinsurer. Applicable for Quota Share treaties. For XOL, this represents the reinsurer's participation percentage in the layer.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the originating Reinsurance Management System record (e.g., Sapiens ReinsurancePro cession ID or SICS record key) for traceability and reconciliation.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: treaty_type
attributes.description: Type of reinsurance treaty structure: Quota Share (QS), Excess of Loss (XOL), Stop Loss (SL), or Catastrophe Excess of Loss (CAT XL). Null for FAC cessions.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; ISO reinsurance standards

attributes.name: ultimate_net_loss
attributes.description: Ultimate Net Loss (UNL) ceded under this cession, representing the reinsurer's share of total incurred losses including LAE. Key metric for XOL treaty performance.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F; ISO reinsurance standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this cession record. Used for change tracking and incremental data pipeline processing.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

products.name: ri_premium_transaction
products.description: Ceded premium ledger. One row per financial movement (written, earned, unearned, return, reinstatement) for a cession. FK to cession, accounting period, treaty layer. Reinstatement rows carry occurrence reference and reinstated limit.
products.reference: Ceded Premium Transaction / Schedule F Premium

attributes.name: ri_premium_transaction_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate key for each reinsurance ceded premium financial movement. One row per written, earned, unearned, return, or reinstatement transaction for a cession. TRANSACTION_HEADER role.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; SAP SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: accounting_period_id
attributes.description: Reference to the accounting period (month/quarter/year) in which this reinsurance premium transaction is booked for statutory and GAAP financial reporting purposes.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement; SAP SSAP No. 62R; GAAP ASC 944

attributes.name: calendar_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.calendar. Business justification: RI premium transactions must be aligned to fiscal/reporting calendar periods for NAIC Schedule F bordereaux submission, GAAP/SAP period-close, and treaty year vs.

attributes.name: cat_zone_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to catastrophegeography.cat_zone. Business justification: Ceded premium transactions require zone attribution for bordereaux reporting, zone-level reinsurance cost allocation, and catastrophe program premium analysis.

attributes.name: cession_id
attributes.description: Reference to the reinsurance cession record that this premium transaction belongs to. Links the financial movement to the specific risk ceded under a treaty or facultative agreement.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; SAP SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: claim_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to claims.claim. Business justification: Reinstatement premiums are triggered by specific claims exhausting a treaty layer limit. Linking ri_premium_transaction to the triggering claim supports reinstatement premium billing, treaty

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.currency. Business justification: RI premium transactions record ceded written/earned premium in multiple currencies. A proper currency FK replaces the denormalized currency_code plain column and enables multi-currency

attributes.name: fac_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reinsurance.fac_agreement. Business justification: Premium transactions can be for facultative placements in addition to treaty layers. Currently has treaty_layer_id. Adding optional fac_agreement_id for FAC premium transactions.

attributes.name: insured_risk_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to riskexposure.insured_risk. Business justification: Facultative RI premium transactions must be allocated to specific insured risks for Schedule F regulatory reporting, risk-level ceded premium accounting, and reinsurer bordereaux.

attributes.name: line_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to policy.line. Business justification: RI premium transactions must be allocated to the specific policy LOB line for bordereaux reporting and LOB-level reinsurance premium accounting.

attributes.name: line_of_business_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.line_of_business. Business justification: Premium transactions must classify by line for GL coding, treaty allocation, and statutory accounting; LOB master provides chart of accounts mappings and ensures consistent line

attributes.name: original_transaction_ri_premium_transaction_id
attributes.description: For reversal or correction transactions, references the ri_premium_transaction_id of the original entry being reversed. Null for original transactions. Supports audit trail and net balance reconciliation.

attributes.name: policy_id
attributes.description: Reference to the underlying direct policy whose premium is being ceded. Required for facultative cessions and policy-level bordereaux reporting under Schedule F.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; SAP SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: policy_term_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific policy term period for which ceded premium is being transacted. Enables reconstruction of in-force ceded premium at any historical date.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; SAP SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: premium_transaction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to premium.premium_transaction. Business justification: Reinsurance premium transactions must trace to the originating gross premium transaction for reconciliation, bordereaux preparation, ceded/net premium calculation, and regulatory

attributes.name: reinsurer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the reinsurer party record (assuming entity in the party domain) to whom the premium is ceded. Required for Schedule F counterparty-level reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; SAP SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: ri_agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the reinsurance agreement (treaty or facultative) under which this premium transaction is recorded. Supports bordereaux reporting and treaty-level premium aggregation.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; SAP SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: treaty_layer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific treaty layer (e.g., first excess, second excess) within a multi-layer XOL or CAT XL program to which this ceded premium is allocated.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; ISO Reinsurance Standards

attributes.name: accident_year
attributes.description: The calendar year in which losses covered by this ceded premium are expected to occur. Used for accident year (AY) loss development triangles and actuarial reserving analysis.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P; SAP SSAP No. 62R; Actuarial Standards of Practice

attributes.name: accounting_date
attributes.description: The date on which this transaction is recognized in the general ledger and statutory accounts. May differ from transaction_date due to period-end cut-off adjustments.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; GAAP ASC 944; SOX

attributes.name: agreement_type
attributes.description: The structural type of the reinsurance agreement: Quota Share (QS), Excess of Loss (XOL), Stop Loss (SL), Catastrophe Excess of Loss (CAT XL), or Surplus Share.
attributes.value_regex: Quota Share|Excess of Loss|Stop Loss|CAT XL|Surplus Share
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: bordereaux_period
attributes.description: The YYYY-MM period for which this transaction is included in the reinsurance bordereaux submission to the reinsurer. Format: YYYY-MM. Drives bordereaux extract and reinsurer statement reconciliation.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; ACORD Standards; SAP SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: bordereaux_status
attributes.description: Tracks the submission lifecycle of this transaction in the reinsurance bordereaux process. Acknowledged by reinsurer confirms premium settlement; Disputed triggers reconciliation workflow.

attributes.name: ceded_earned_premium
attributes.description: The pro-rata portion of ceded written premium recognized as earned during the accounting period. Used for ceded loss ratio and earned premium calculations in Schedule P and Schedule F.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule P; GAAP ASC 944

attributes.name: ceded_unearned_premium
attributes.description: The portion of ceded written premium not yet earned as of the accounting date. Represents the reinsurer's liability for the unexpired policy period. Required for NAIC Annual Statement balance sheet.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Annual Statement; GAAP ASC 944

attributes.name: ceded_written_premium
attributes.description: The portion of written premium transferred to the reinsurer under this cession. For QS treaties, equals GWP multiplied by the cession percentage. Core field for NWP and DPW calculations.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F; GAAP ASC 944

attributes.name: ceding_commission
attributes.description: Commission paid by the reinsurer to the cedant to offset acquisition and administrative costs. Expressed as a flat amount per transaction. Reduces the net cost of reinsurance.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F; GAAP ASC 944

attributes.name: ceding_commission_rate
attributes.description: The rate applied to ceded written premium to calculate the ceding commission (e.g., 0.2500 = 25%). Used for sliding-scale commission calculations under profit-sharing treaties.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: cession_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of the underlying risk ceded to the reinsurer under a quota share or surplus share treaty (e.g., 0.3000 = 30%). Null for XOL treaties where cession is event-triggered.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: cession_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the ceded premium relates to a treaty arrangement, a facultative (FAC) placement, or a retrocession. Drives bordereaux format and Schedule F classification.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; SAP SSAP No. 62R; ISO Reinsurance Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this reinsurance premium transaction record was first created in the reinsurance management system (Sapiens ReinsurancePro or SICS).

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: Exchange rate used to convert foreign currency amounts to the cedant's functional reporting currency (USD). Applied as of the accounting_date for statutory reporting purposes.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; SAP SSAP No. 23; IFRS 17

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: The general ledger account code to which this reinsurance premium transaction is posted in the statutory accounting system (Oracle/SAP GL). Required for Schedule F and NAIC Annual Statement mapping.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Annual Statement; SOX

attributes.name: gross_written_premium
attributes.description: The total direct written premium on the underlying policy before any reinsurance cession. Base for calculating the ceded share under quota share or facultative agreements.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Annual Statement; GAAP ASC 944

attributes.name: occurrence_reference_code
attributes.description: Reference to the loss occurrence or catastrophe event that triggered a reinstatement premium. Populated only for transaction_type = Reinstatement. Links to the loss event record.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; ISO Reinsurance Standards; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: policy_effective_date
attributes.description: The date the underlying direct policy became effective. Used to assign the ceded premium to the correct policy year (PY) for actuarial and Schedule P/F reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P; NAIC Schedule F; SAP SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: policy_expiration_date
attributes.description: The date the underlying direct policy expires. Used to calculate the unearned premium period and pro-rata earning of ceded premium over the policy term.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: policy_year
attributes.description: The year in which the underlying policy was written. Used for policy year (PY) experience analysis and reinsurance program performance monitoring per NAIC Schedule F.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; NAIC Schedule P; SAP SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: profit_commission
attributes.description: Contingent commission earned by the cedant when the reinsurer's loss ratio on the treaty falls below a specified threshold. Booked as a reduction in net reinsurance cost.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: rate_on_line
attributes.description: The reinsurance premium expressed as a percentage of the treaty limit (ROL = premium / limit). Key pricing metric for XOL and CAT XL treaties used in actuarial and underwriting analysis.
attributes.references: ISO Reinsurance Standards; SAP SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: reinstated_limit
attributes.description: The amount of treaty limit reinstated following a loss occurrence, for which the reinstatement_premium is charged. Applicable only when transaction_type = Reinstatement.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; ISO Reinsurance Standards

attributes.name: reinstatement_premium
attributes.description: Additional premium paid to the reinsurer to reinstate exhausted treaty limit following a loss occurrence. Applicable to XOL and CAT XL treaties. Linked to occurrence_reference_id.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; ISO Reinsurance Standards; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: reporting_currency_amount

products.description: Property-line subtype of insured_risk. One row per property risk. Captures COPE attributes (Construction, Occupancy, Protection, Exposure), ITV, year built, square footage, and ISO construction class for rating and CAT modeling.

attributes.name: property_risk_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the property_risk data product (auto-inserted during validation).

attributes.name: insured_risk_id
attributes.description: Foreign key to the parent insured risk supertype record.

attributes.name: line_of_business_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.line_of_business. Business justification: Property risks span multiple LOBs (commercial property, homeowners, dwelling fire, inland marine) with distinct ISO forms, rating plans, and state filing requirements.

attributes.name: policy_term_id
attributes.description: Foreign key to the policy term under which this property risk is insured.

attributes.name: property_owner_party_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to party.party. Business justification: Property underwriting requires direct link to property owner party for title verification, loss payee validation, and insured interest determination.

attributes.name: territory_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to catastrophegeography.territory. Business justification: Property risk territory assignment drives ISO loss cost selection, rate filings, and TIV accumulation reporting by territory for property lines.

attributes.name: actual_cash_value
attributes.description: The replacement cost value minus depreciation. Used for certain policy forms and loss settlement.

attributes.name: basement_finish_type
attributes.description: The level of finish in the basement, if present. Impacts valuation and loss potential.

attributes.name: basement_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the property has a basement. Impacts flood and water damage risk.

attributes.name: burglar_alarm_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the property has a burglar or intrusion alarm system. May provide premium credit.

attributes.name: central_station_monitoring_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether alarm systems are monitored by a central station. Provides additional premium credit.

attributes.name: coinsurance_percentage
attributes.description: The coinsurance percentage required by the policy form, typically 80%, 90%, or 100%. Used to calculate coinsurance penalties at claim time.

attributes.name: construction_type
attributes.description: The construction class of the building. Part of COPE attributes. Examples: frame, joisted masonry, non-combustible, masonry non-combustible, modified fire resistive, fire resistive.

attributes.name: cooling_type
attributes.description: The type of cooling or air conditioning system. Examples: central air, window units, evaporative, none.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this property risk record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: distance_to_fire_hydrant_feet
attributes.description: Distance in feet from the property to the nearest fire hydrant. Impacts protection class and rating.

attributes.name: distance_to_fire_station_miles
attributes.description: Distance in miles from the property to the nearest responding fire station. Impacts protection class and rating.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which this property risk record is effective under the policy term.

attributes.name: electrical_system_type
attributes.description: The type of electrical system. Examples: circuit breaker, fuse box, knob and tube. Impacts fire risk.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which this property risk record expires or is no longer in force under the policy term.

attributes.name: exposure_description
attributes.description: Description of external exposures that may increase risk. Part of COPE attributes. Examples: proximity to brush, adjacent buildings, hazardous operations nearby.

attributes.name: fire_alarm_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the property has a fire alarm or smoke detection system. May provide premium credit.

attributes.name: foundation_type
attributes.description: The type of foundation supporting the structure. Impacts flood and earthquake risk.

attributes.name: heating_type
attributes.description: The type of heating system. Examples: forced air, electric, oil, gas, heat pump, wood stove. Impacts fire and equipment breakdown risk.

attributes.name: insurance_to_value_percentage
attributes.description: The ratio of insured value to replacement cost value, expressed as a percentage. Used to assess adequacy of coverage and apply coinsurance penalties.

attributes.name: iso_construction_code
attributes.description: ISO standard construction classification code used for rating and catastrophe modeling.

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the property risk, often used in underwriting and rating systems.

attributes.name: number_of_stories
attributes.description: The number of above-ground stories or floors in the building.

attributes.name: number_of_units
attributes.description: The number of dwelling units or rental units in the property, if applicable for multi-family or commercial properties.

attributes.name: occupancy_type
attributes.description: The use or occupancy of the property. Part of COPE attributes for underwriting and rating. Examples: owner-occupied, tenant-occupied, retail, office, manufacturing, warehouse.

attributes.name: plumbing_type
attributes.description: The type of plumbing material. Examples: copper, PVC, galvanized, PEX. Impacts water damage risk.

attributes.name: property_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the property risk record within the policy term.

attributes.name: protection_class
attributes.description: ISO Public Protection Classification or similar fire protection rating. Part of COPE attributes. Lower numbers indicate better fire protection.

attributes.name: replacement_cost_value
attributes.description: The estimated cost to replace the property with materials of like kind and quality at current prices.

attributes.name: roof_shape
attributes.description: The architectural shape of the roof. Impacts wind resistance and catastrophe modeling.

attributes.name: roof_type
attributes.description: The type of roofing material. Examples: asphalt shingle, tile, metal, flat, slate. Impacts wind and hail risk.

attributes.name: roof_year
attributes.description: The year the roof was installed or last replaced. Used for age-based rating and underwriting decisions.

attributes.name: sprinkler_system_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the property has an automatic fire sprinkler system. Provides premium credit and reduces fire loss potential.

attributes.name: square_footage
attributes.description: Total square footage of the property. Used for rating, valuation, and catastrophe exposure aggregation.

attributes.name: total_insured_value
attributes.description: The total insured value of the property risk. Used for catastrophe exposure aggregation, reinsurance cession, and PML modeling.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this property risk record was last modified.

attributes.name: valuation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the property was last valued or appraised.

attributes.name: valuation_method
attributes.description: The method used to determine the insured value. Examples: appraisal, cost estimator tool, market value, agreed value, stated amount.

attributes.name: year_built
attributes.description: The year the property was originally constructed. Used for age-based rating and risk assessment.

attributes.name: year_renovated
attributes.description: The year of the most recent major renovation or remodel, if applicable.

products.name: location
products.description: Physical address and geocoded site associated with a property risk. One row per insured location. Stores street address, lat/long, FIPS code, territory code, flood zone, and links to geography hierarchy for CAT aggregation.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to party.address. Business justification: Underwriting territory rating, geocoding, and catastrophe zone assignment all require the canonical party.address record for a risk location.

attributes.name: cat_zone_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to catastrophegeography.cat_zone. Business justification: Locations require catastrophe zone assignment for real-time accumulation limit monitoring during quoting, underwriting guideline enforcement (moratorium checks), and reinsurance

attributes.name: policy_id
attributes.description: Reference to the policy under which this location is insured.

attributes.name: property_risk_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent property risk entity for this location.

attributes.name: territory_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to catastrophegeography.territory. Business justification: Location-level territory assignment is used for property rating, ISO loss cost application, and TIV concentration reporting by territory.

attributes.name: alarm_type
attributes.description: Type of fire or burglar alarm system installed at the location. Used for rating credits.

attributes.name: building_limit
attributes.description: Coverage limit for the building structure at this location. Part of TIV calculation.

attributes.name: business_income_limit
attributes.description: Coverage limit for business interruption or time element coverage at this location. Part of TIV calculation.

attributes.name: coastal_distance_miles
attributes.description: Distance in miles from the location to the nearest coastline. Used for hurricane and storm surge exposure assessment.

attributes.name: construction_type
attributes.description: ISO construction class for the primary building at this location. Part of COPE data used for rating and catastrophe modeling.

attributes.name: contents_limit
attributes.description: Coverage limit for business personal property and contents at this location. Part of TIV calculation.

attributes.name: county_name
attributes.description: County or parish name for the location. Used for regulatory and catastrophe aggregation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this location record was first created in the system. Used for audit and data lineage.

attributes.name: deductible_amount
attributes.description: Standard deductible amount applicable to losses at this location. May be overridden by peril-specific deductibles.

attributes.name: earthquake_deductible_percent
attributes.description: Percentage deductible applied to earthquake losses at this location. Common in seismic zones.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date this location became effective under the policy. Used for temporal queries and loss date matching.

attributes.name: elevation_feet
attributes.description: Elevation of the location above sea level in feet. Used for flood and storm surge risk modeling.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date this location expires or was removed from the policy. Null for currently active locations.

attributes.name: fips_code
attributes.description: Five-digit FIPS code identifying the county. Used for catastrophe modeling and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: fire_station_distance_miles
attributes.description: Distance in miles from the location to the nearest fire station. Used for protection class rating.

attributes.name: flood_zone
attributes.description: FEMA flood zone classification for the location. Determines flood risk and eligibility for NFIP coverage.

attributes.name: geocode_accuracy
attributes.description: Precision level of the geocoded coordinates. Rooftop is most precise, county is least precise.

attributes.name: hydrant_distance_feet
attributes.description: Distance in feet from the location to the nearest fire hydrant. Used for protection class rating.

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geocoded latitude coordinate of the location. Used for catastrophe exposure aggregation and mapping.

attributes.name: location_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the location within the policy. Active locations are in force and contribute to exposure.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geocoded longitude coordinate of the location. Used for catastrophe exposure aggregation and mapping.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this location record was last modified. Used for audit and change tracking.
