attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time this assignment record was last updated in the data warehouse.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: The priority assigned to this claim assignment, influencing adjuster workflow and response time.

attributes.name: reassignment_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating why the claim was reassigned from a previous adjuster.

attributes.name: reassignment_reason_description
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of why the assignment was transferred to this adjuster.

attributes.name: reserve_authority_limit
attributes.description: The maximum reserve amount the adjuster can set without supervisor approval for this assignment.

attributes.name: service_level_agreement_days
attributes.description: The number of days within which the adjuster must take initial action or complete key milestones per service level agreement.

attributes.name: settlement_authority_limit
attributes.description: The maximum settlement amount the adjuster can approve without escalation for this assignment.

attributes.name: specialty_line
attributes.description: The line of business specialty for which the adjuster was assigned: property, auto, liability, workers compensation, etc.

attributes.name: workload_at_assignment
attributes.description: The number of open claims the adjuster had at the time of this assignment, used for workload balancing analysis.

products.name: fnol
products.description: First Notice of Loss intake record. Grain: one row per FNOL submission. Captures report channel, reporter party, initial loss description, date/time of loss, and triage flags before a formal claim is opened.

attributes.name: fnol_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the FNOL submission record.

attributes.name: assigned_adjuster_id
attributes.description: Reference to the adjuster assigned to investigate the FNOL, if assigned during intake.

attributes.name: cat_zone_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to catastrophegeography.cat_zone. Business justification: FNOL triage uses cat zone to route incoming loss reports to cat-qualified adjusters and apply cat SLAs.

attributes.name: catastrophe_event_id
attributes.description: Reference to the catastrophe event if the loss is CAT-related.

attributes.name: claim_id
attributes.description: Reference to the formal claim record created from this FNOL, if opened.

attributes.name: coverage_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific coverage under which the loss is being reported, if known at FNOL time.

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.currency. Business justification: estimated_loss_amount on FNOL is a monetary value used for initial reserve setting and large-loss triage.

attributes.name: driver_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to riskexposure.driver. Business justification: Auto FNOL — identifying the driver at first notice is required for excluded-driver triage, coverage-in-doubt flagging, and SIU referral decisions.

attributes.name: insured_risk_id
attributes.description: Reference to the insured risk (property, vehicle, driver) involved in the loss, if identified at FNOL time.

attributes.name: line_of_business_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.line_of_business. Business justification: FNOL triage, adjuster routing, and SLA assignment are driven by LOB. The existing lob plain-text column is a denormalization of the shared LOB entity.

attributes.name: loss_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to claims.loss_event. Business justification: An FNOL submission may be matched to a master loss event record once the event is identified (e.g., a catastrophe or multi-claim occurrence).

attributes.name: peril_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to catastrophegeography.catastrophegeography_peril. Business justification: Normalizes peril classification at first notice of loss, enabling peril-based triage routing, specialist adjuster assignment, and cat flag determination.

attributes.name: policy_id
attributes.description: Reference to the policy under which the loss is being reported.

attributes.name: producers_producer_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to producers.producers_producer. Business justification: Captures which producer reported the loss when reporter_party_role indicates producer involvement.

attributes.name: reporter_party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the party who reported the loss (policyholder, agent, claimant, or third party).

attributes.name: reporter_party_role_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific role the reporter was acting in at the time of report (policyholder, named insured, agent, claimant).

attributes.name: vehicle_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to riskexposure.vehicle. Business justification: Auto FNOL triage — rental car initiation, total-loss pre-screening, and glass/roadside dispatch at first notice require the specific vehicle (VIN, make/model, ACV).

attributes.name: cat_event_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the loss is associated with a declared catastrophe event.

attributes.name: claim_opened_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal claim record has been created from this FNOL submission.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the FNOL record was first created in the claims management system.

attributes.name: estimated_loss_amount
attributes.description: Initial estimate of the loss amount provided by the reporter at the time of FNOL.

attributes.name: fatality_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a fatality occurred as part of the loss event.

attributes.name: fnol_status
attributes.description: Current status of the FNOL submission in the intake and triage workflow.

attributes.name: fraud_indicator_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the FNOL has been flagged for potential fraud based on initial screening rules.

attributes.name: injury_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether bodily injury was reported as part of the loss.

attributes.name: iso_cat_serial_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Insurance Services Office (ISO) Catastrophe (CAT) Serial Number
attributes.description: ISO-assigned catastrophe serial number for industry-wide catastrophe event tracking.

tag_set.value: Insurance Services Office (ISO) Catastrophe (CAT) Serial Number

attributes.name: loss_cause
attributes.description: Preliminary cause or peril of the loss as reported (fire, theft, collision, wind, water, liability, etc.).

attributes.name: loss_date
attributes.description: Date the loss or incident occurred as reported by the reporter.

attributes.name: loss_description
attributes.description: Initial narrative description of the loss event as provided by the reporter.

attributes.name: loss_location_address
attributes.description: Street address where the loss occurred.

attributes.name: loss_location_city
attributes.description: City where the loss occurred.

attributes.name: loss_location_country
attributes.description: Country where the loss occurred, using 3-letter ISO country code.

attributes.name: loss_location_postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code of the loss location.

attributes.name: loss_location_state
attributes.description: State or province where the loss occurred.

attributes.name: loss_time
attributes.description: Time of day the loss occurred, if known and reported.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the FNOL record was last updated.

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the FNOL submission, often displayed to users and external parties.

attributes.name: police_department
attributes.description: Name of the police department or law enforcement agency that took the report.

attributes.name: police_report_filed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a police report was filed for the loss event.

attributes.name: police_report_number
attributes.description: Police report or incident number, if a report was filed.

attributes.name: property_damage_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether property damage was reported as part of the loss.

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Reason the FNOL was rejected or not converted to a formal claim, if applicable.

attributes.name: report_channel
attributes.description: Channel through which the loss was reported.

attributes.name: report_date
attributes.description: Date the loss was reported to the insurer.

attributes.name: report_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time the FNOL was submitted or received by the system.

attributes.name: reporter_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the reporter for follow-up communication.

attributes.name: reporter_contact_phone
attributes.description: Phone number of the reporter for follow-up communication.

attributes.name: siu_referral_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the FNOL has been referred to the Special Investigations Unit for fraud investigation.

attributes.name: third_party_involved_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a third party (non-insured) is involved in the loss event.

attributes.name: triage_priority
attributes.description: Priority level assigned to the FNOL for adjuster assignment and investigation, based on severity and complexity.

products.name: litigation
products.description: Litigation record attached to a claim. Tracks lawsuit filing date, plaintiff attorney, defense counsel, court jurisdiction, trial date, verdict, and settlement amount. One row per lawsuit per claim.

attributes.name: litigation_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the litigation record. Primary key.

attributes.name: assigned_adjuster_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the adjuster assigned to manage this litigation.

attributes.name: catastrophe_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to catastrophegeography.catastrophe_event. Business justification: Cat-related litigation (bad faith, coverage disputes post-hurricane/flood) must be tracked against the triggering catastrophe event for reinsurance bad faith cost

attributes.name: claim_exposure_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to claims.claim_exposure. Business justification: Litigation is frequently tied to a specific coverage line (claim exposure) rather than the entire claim — e.g., a bodily injury lawsuit targets the BI coverage exposure specifically.

attributes.name: claim_id
attributes.description: Foreign key to the claim that this litigation is attached to.

attributes.name: claimant_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to claims.claimant. Business justification: A lawsuit is filed by a specific claimant party. Linking litigation directly to the claimant record (beyond the claim-level link) enables precise tracking of which claimant is the plaintiff

attributes.name: coverage_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to coverage.coverage. Business justification: Litigation defense strategy, reserve authority, and settlement negotiations require direct reference to the specific coverage part in dispute.

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.currency. Business justification: litigation carries defense_cost_incurred, demand_amount, reserve_amount, settlement_amount, and verdict_amount — all monetary.

attributes.name: defense_counsel_party_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to party.party. Business justification: Defense attorneys are parties requiring tracking for legal billing, conflict checks, panel counsel management, and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: appeal_date
attributes.description: Date the appeal was filed.

attributes.name: appeal_filed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether an appeal has been filed following the verdict.

attributes.name: cause_of_action
attributes.description: Legal basis or grounds for the lawsuit, such as negligence, breach of contract, or bad faith.

attributes.name: closure_date
attributes.description: Date the litigation was formally closed in the claims system.

attributes.name: confidentiality_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the litigation settlement or details are subject to a confidentiality agreement.

attributes.name: court_jurisdiction
attributes.description: Name of the court or jurisdiction where the lawsuit is filed, including district or county.

attributes.name: court_type
attributes.description: Type or level of court handling the litigation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the litigation record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: defense_cost_incurred
attributes.description: Total defense and cost containment expenses incurred for this litigation.

attributes.name: demand_amount
attributes.description: Monetary amount demanded by the plaintiff in the lawsuit.

attributes.name: dismissal_date
attributes.description: Date the lawsuit was dismissed by the court.

attributes.name: dismissal_reason
attributes.description: Reason provided for the dismissal of the lawsuit, such as lack of jurisdiction or settlement.

attributes.name: filing_date
attributes.description: Date the lawsuit was filed with the court.

attributes.name: lawsuit_number
attributes.description: Court-assigned case number or docket number for the lawsuit.

attributes.name: litigation_status
attributes.description: Current status of the litigation in its lifecycle. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: filed|discovery|mediation|trial|settled|dismissed|verdict_rendered|appeal|closed — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: litigation_type
attributes.description: Classification of the litigation based on the nature of the dispute.

attributes.name: mediation_date
attributes.description: Date of scheduled or completed mediation session.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes capturing key details, strategy, or updates related to the litigation.

attributes.name: plaintiff_attorney_firm
attributes.description: Law firm name representing the plaintiff.

attributes.name: plaintiff_attorney_name
attributes.description: Name of the attorney or law firm representing the plaintiff.

attributes.name: plaintiff_attorney_phone
attributes.description: Contact phone number for the plaintiff attorney.

attributes.name: plaintiff_name
attributes.description: Name of the plaintiff or claimant who filed the lawsuit.

attributes.name: reserve_amount
attributes.description: Total reserve amount set aside for this litigation, including indemnity and defense costs.

attributes.name: settlement_amount
attributes.description: Total monetary amount agreed upon in the settlement.

attributes.name: settlement_date
attributes.description: Date the litigation was settled, if applicable.

attributes.name: trial_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the trial or hearing.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the litigation record was last updated.

attributes.name: venue_county
attributes.description: County where the lawsuit is being heard.

attributes.name: venue_state
attributes.description: State where the lawsuit is being heard.

attributes.name: verdict_amount
attributes.description: Monetary award determined by the court or jury in the verdict.

attributes.name: verdict_date
attributes.description: Date the court or jury rendered a verdict.

attributes.name: verdict_type
attributes.description: Outcome of the verdict indicating which party prevailed.

domains.name: claimfinancials
domains.description: Provisional description for user-specified domain 'claim_financials'. Awaiting a generated description of what this domain owns.

products.name: reserve
products.description: Grain: one row per financial movement per claim exposure. Each record represents a single reserve transaction (Case/IBNR/LAE) recorded per Claim Exposure and Accounting Period.

attributes.name: reserve_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each reserve position record. One row per reserve type per claim exposure per accounting period. Grain: one reserve movement per claim exposure per period.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P; SAP SSAP No. 55

attributes.name: accounting_period_id
attributes.description: Reference to the accounting period in which this reserve position is recorded. Enables calendar year, accident year, and policy year reserve triangles.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 55; NAIC Annual Statement Schedule P

attributes.name: adjuster_id
attributes.description: Reference to the adjuster who authorized or last modified this reserve position. Required for reserve authority and audit trail.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter Reserving module; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: approved_by_party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the party (supervisor or manager) who approved this reserve movement when it exceeded adjuster authority limits. Null if no approval was required.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter; SOX; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: claim_exposure_id
attributes.description: Reference to the claim exposure (coverage line within a claim) to which this reserve position belongs. Links reserve to a specific coverage and insured risk within the claim.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter Reserving module; NAIC Schedule P

attributes.name: claim_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent claim record. Denormalized for direct claim-level aggregation and reporting without joining through claim exposure.

attributes.name: coverage_id
attributes.description: Reference to the coverage under which this reserve is established. Supports reserve analysis by coverage type and line of business.

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.currency. Business justification: Multi-currency claim operations require currency master for exchange rate lookup, functional currency conversion, rounding rules, and financial consolidation.

attributes.name: financial_transaction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to claimfinancials.financial_transaction. Business justification: Every reserve movement (case, IBNR, LAE) generates an atomic double-entry posting in financial_transaction.

attributes.name: line_of_business_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.line_of_business. Business justification: Actuarial reserve adequacy analysis, NAIC Schedule P reporting, and regulatory reserve filings require joining reserve transactions to LOB master for proper line classification, loss

attributes.name: litigation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to claims.litigation. Business justification: Litigation reserves are a distinct reserve category (reserve_category field confirms this) set when a claim enters suit.

attributes.name: policy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to policy.policy. Business justification: Reserves are established against specific policies for loss reserve adequacy analysis, IBNR calculations, and statutory reserve reporting.

attributes.name: policy_term_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to policy.term. Business justification: Reserves must link to policy term for accurate loss ratio calculations, earned premium matching, and Schedule P development triangle reporting by accident year and policy year.

attributes.name: ri_claim_cession_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reinsurance.ri_claim_cession. Business justification: Ceded case reserves and IBNR are booked per claim-level cession for Schedule P and NAIC reporting.

attributes.name: ri_recovery_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reinsurance.ri_recovery. Business justification: RI recoveries reduce ceded reserves; actuaries link ri_recovery to reserve movements for ceded IBNR runoff and Schedule P loss development analysis.

attributes.name: riskexposure_auto_risk_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to riskexposure.auto_risk. Business justification: Auto liability reserve adequacy benchmarking requires auto risk attributes (territory, use class, radius of operation) for actuarial development factor selection.

attributes.name: riskexposure_insured_risk_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to riskexposure.insured_risk. Business justification: Actuaries segment reserve adequacy by risk characteristics (construction type, protection class, vehicle type, driver profile) for accurate loss development and catastrophe

attributes.name: accident_year
attributes.description: The calendar year in which the loss event occurred. Used for accident year (AY) loss triangle development and actuarial reserving analysis per NAIC Schedule P.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P; Actuarial Standards of Practice (ASOP) No. 43

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the reserve movement was approved by the authorizing supervisor or manager. Null if no approval was required for this movement.

attributes.name: authority_limit_amount
attributes.description: Maximum reserve amount the authorizing adjuster is permitted to set without escalation per the claims reserving authority matrix. Supports reserve governance and SOX controls.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter; SOX; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: basis
attributes.description: Indicates whether the reserve amounts are stated on a Gross (before reinsurance), Net (after reinsurance), or Ceded (reinsurer share only) basis for this record.
attributes.references: NAIC SSAP No. 55; NAIC Schedule F; IFRS 17

attributes.name: case_reserve_adequacy_flag
attributes.description: Actuarial or supervisory assessment of whether the case reserve is adequate relative to the expected ultimate loss. Used in reserve review and ORSA reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC ORSA; ASOP No. 43; SAP SSAP No. 55

attributes.name: catastrophe_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this reserve is associated with a declared catastrophe event. Enables CAT vs. non-CAT reserve segregation for PML analysis and reinsurance recovery tracking.
attributes.references: ISO PCS Catastrophe Bulletin; NAIC Schedule P; RMS RiskLink

attributes.name: reserve_category
attributes.description: Broad financial category of the reserve: Loss (indemnity), Expense (LAE/DCC/AO), Salvage (anticipated recovery from salvage), or Subrogation (anticipated recovery from third parties).
attributes.references: NAIC SSAP No. 55; SAP Statutory Accounting

attributes.name: ceded_closing_balance_amount
attributes.description: Portion of the closing reserve balance ceded to reinsurers. Net reserve equals closing balance minus ceded closing balance. Required for Schedule F statutory reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; SAP SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: ceded_movement_amount
attributes.description: Incremental change in the ceded reserve portion during the accounting period. Supports net reserve calculation and reinsurance bordereaux reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; SAP SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: ceded_opening_balance_amount
attributes.description: Portion of the opening reserve balance ceded to reinsurers under applicable treaties or facultative agreements. Used for net reserve and Schedule F reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; SAP SSAP No. 62R; IFRS 17

attributes.name: closing_balance_amount
attributes.description: Reserve balance at the end of the accounting period for this claim exposure and reserve type. Equals opening balance plus movement amount. Gross of reinsurance.
attributes.references: NAIC SSAP No. 55; GAAP ASC 944; IFRS 17

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: Internal cost center to which this reserve is allocated for management accounting and expense reporting purposes. Supports departmental P&L and RBC capital allocation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this reserve record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail, SOX compliance, and data lineage tracking in the lakehouse silver layer.
attributes.references: SOX; NAIC Market Conduct Standards; GLBA

attributes.name: development_period
attributes.description: Number of months elapsed from the accident year start to the end of the accounting period. Used to position this reserve in the loss development triangle (e.g., 12, 24, 36 months).
attributes.references: ASOP No. 43; NAIC Schedule P; Actuarial Reserving System

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which this reserve position becomes effective for financial reporting purposes. May differ from the transaction date for period-end adjustments and actuarial entries.
attributes.references: NAIC SSAP No. 55; GAAP ASC 944; IFRS 17

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: General ledger account code to which this reserve movement is posted in the statutory and GAAP accounting systems. Supports financial close and Schedule P reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP/Oracle GL; NAIC Annual Statement; SOX; GAAP ASC 944

attributes.name: ibnr_factor
attributes.description: Actuarial development factor applied to derive the IBNR reserve component. Sourced from the actuarial reserving system loss development triangle for the applicable LOB and accident year.
attributes.references: ASOP No. 43; NAIC Schedule P; Data Warehouse / Actuarial Reserving System

attributes.name: loss_date
attributes.description: Date of the underlying loss event that gave rise to this claim and reserve. Denormalized from the claim for accident year triangle development without additional joins.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P; ASOP No. 43; Guidewire ClaimCenter

attributes.name: method
attributes.description: Methodology used to establish or update this reserve: Case_Estimate (adjuster judgment), Formula (system-calculated), Actuarial (actuarial model output), Bulk (portfolio-level), or Tabular (mortality/morbidity table).
attributes.references: ASOP No. 43; NAIC Schedule P; SAP SSAP No. 55

attributes.name: movement_amount
attributes.description: Incremental change to the reserve during the accounting period. Positive value indicates reserve strengthening; negative value indicates reserve release. Gross of reinsurance.
attributes.references: NAIC SSAP No. 55; GAAP ASC 944; IFRS 17

attributes.name: movement_reason_code
attributes.description: Coded reason for the reserve movement in this period (e.g., NEW_RESERVE, STRENGTHENING, PARTIAL_RELEASE, FULL_RELEASE, PAYMENT_OFFSET, REOPEN). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter Reserving module; NAIC Schedule P

attributes.name: movement_reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative provided by the adjuster or actuarial team explaining the basis for the reserve movement. Supports audit trail and reserve review documentation.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Externally visible business identifier for this reserve record, typically assigned by the claims management system. Used in bordereaux and statutory reporting.

attributes.name: opening_balance_amount
attributes.description: Reserve balance carried forward from the prior accounting period for this claim exposure and reserve type. Starting point for the period movement calculation.
attributes.references: NAIC SSAP No. 55; GAAP ASC 944; IFRS 17

attributes.name: policy_year
attributes.description: The year in which the policy that generated this claim was written. Supports policy year (PY) reserve development triangles distinct from accident year analysis.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P; SAP Statutory Accounting

attributes.name: reinsurance_recoverable_amount
attributes.description: Estimated reinsurance recoverable on this reserve position based on applicable treaty or facultative cession. Supports Schedule F reporting and net reserve calculation.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; SAP SSAP No. 62R; IFRS 17

attributes.name: report_date
attributes.description: Date the claim was first reported to the insurer (FNOL date). Used to compute report lag and support IBNR development analysis in actuarial reserving.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P; ASOP No. 43; Guidewire ClaimCenter FNOL module

attributes.name: requires_supervisor_approval
attributes.description: Indicates whether this reserve movement exceeded the adjuster authority limit and required supervisor or management approval before posting.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter; SOX Internal Controls; NAIC Market Conduct

attributes.name: reserve_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the reserve position. Open reserves are active; Closed reserves have been fully settled or released; Reopened indicates a previously closed reserve reactivated.

attributes.name: reserve_type
attributes.description: Classification of the reserve: Case (known reported loss), IBNR (Incurred But Not Reported), LAE (Loss Adjustment Expense), ULAE (Unallocated LAE), ALAE (Allocated LAE), or DCC (Defense & Cost Containment).
attributes.references: NAIC SSAP No. 55; SAP; Schedule P Instructions

attributes.name: salvage_anticipated_amount
attributes.description: Estimated salvage recovery anticipated on this claim exposure. Reduces the net reserve position and is reported separately in NAIC statutory filings.
attributes.references: NAIC SSAP No. 55; SAP Statutory Accounting; Guidewire ClaimCenter

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system that originated this reserve record: ClaimCenter, DuckCreek, Legacy, Manual (spreadsheet entry), or Actuarial (reserving system upload).
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter; Duck Creek Claims; Data Warehouse / Actuarial Reserving System

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code where the insured risk is located or the loss occurred. Required for state-level Schedule P statutory reporting and DOI regulatory filings.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Schedule P; State DOI regulations; ISO

attributes.name: subrogation_anticipated_amount
attributes.description: Estimated subrogation recovery anticipated on this claim exposure. Reduces the net reserve position and is tracked separately for recovery management and statutory reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC SSAP No. 55; SAP Statutory Accounting; Guidewire ClaimCenter Recovery module

attributes.name: transaction_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the reserve movement was entered into the claims management system. Used for CY (Calendar Year) reporting and reconciliation to the general ledger.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter; NAIC Annual Statement; SAP

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this reserve record. Used for incremental data pipeline processing, audit trail, and change data capture in the lakehouse.
attributes.references: SOX; NAIC Market Conduct Standards; GLBA

products.name: claim_payment
products.description: Grain: one row per financial movement per claim exposure. Each record represents a single payment transaction recorded per Claim Exposure and Accounting Period.

attributes.name: claim_payment_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each claim payment disbursement record. Primary key. One row per payment per claim exposure per accounting period.

attributes.name: accounting_period_id
attributes.description: Reference to the accounting period in which this payment is recognized for statutory and GAAP financial reporting purposes.

attributes.name: catastrophe_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to catastrophegeography.catastrophe_event. Business justification: Cat-event-level payment aggregation is required for reinsurance bordereaux reporting and treaty recovery billing.

attributes.name: claim_exposure_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific coverage line within the claim (Claim Exposure) against which this payment is charged. Grain anchor per VREQ-007.

attributes.name: claim_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent claim under which this payment is issued. Links payment to the reported loss event.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter; NAIC Annual Statement Schedule P

attributes.name: claim_party_id
attributes.description: System user ID of the claims examiner or supervisor who authorized this payment within the authority limit matrix.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; Guidewire ClaimCenter; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: claim_payee_party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Party record identifying the individual or organization receiving this payment (claimant, vendor, attorney, lienholder, loss payee).

attributes.name: claimant_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to claims.claimant. Business justification: Settlement payments are issued to specific claimants. This FK enables per-claimant payment reconciliation, release-signed-date validation before disbursement, 1099 reporting at the claimant

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.currency. Business justification: International claim payments require currency master for exchange rate application, withholding tax calculation, bank account validation, and functional currency conversion.

attributes.name: line_of_business_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.line_of_business. Business justification: Payment authority limits, commission calculations, and loss ratio monitoring are configured by line of business.

attributes.name: litigation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to claims.litigation. Business justification: Settlement and verdict payments directly close or partially satisfy litigation matters. Linking payment to litigation enables litigation cost-to-close analysis, verdict vs.

attributes.name: original_payment_claim_payment_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing identifier pointing to the original payment record when this row represents a reissue or replacement. Null for original disbursements.

attributes.name: payee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to claimfinancials.payee. Business justification: claim_payment carries denormalized payee_name and payee_tax_number that duplicate the authoritative claimfinancials.payee master record.

attributes.name: policy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to policy.policy. Business justification: Payments are made under specific policies for deductible application, policy limit tracking, aggregate limit monitoring, and premium-to-loss reconciliation.

attributes.name: policy_term_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to policy.term. Business justification: Payments must match to the policy term in force at loss date for accurate loss ratio, combined ratio, and loss development analysis by underwriting year.

attributes.name: ri_claim_cession_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reinsurance.ri_claim_cession. Business justification: Ceded claim payments are billed to reinsurers against specific claim cessions via bordereaux and cash calls.

attributes.name: ri_recovery_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reinsurance.ri_recovery. Business justification: RI recovery collections are reconciled against specific claim payments for cash application and aged-receivables reporting.

attributes.name: accident_year

attributes.name: ap_batch_number

attributes.name: authority_limit_amount

attributes.name: check_eft_reference

attributes.name: cost_center_code

attributes.name: coverage_type_code

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: deductible_offset_amount

attributes.name: gl_account_code

attributes.name: gross_payment_amount

attributes.name: is_1099_reportable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this payment must be reported to the IRS on Form 1099-MISC or 1099-NEC. Drives year-end tax reporting extract.

attributes.name: is_final_payment
attributes.description: Indicates this payment closes the claim exposure financially. When true, triggers reserve release and exposure closure workflow in ClaimCenter.

attributes.name: is_structured_settlement
attributes.description: Indicates whether this payment is part of a structured settlement annuity arrangement rather than a lump-sum disbursement.

attributes.name: loss_category
attributes.description: Detailed loss sub-category classifying the nature of the payment: Bodily Injury (BI), Property Damage (PD), Medical Payments (MP), Uninsured Motorist (UM), etc.

attributes.name: net_payment_amount
attributes.description: Actual amount disbursed to the payee after withholding and deductions. Net = gross_payment_amount minus withholding_amount.

attributes.name: payment_authorization_code

attributes.references: SOX Section 404; Guidewire ClaimCenter Authority Matrix; NAIC Market Conduct

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the payment was issued or disbursed to the payee. Used for calendar year (CY) and accident year (AY) loss reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement; SAP/SSAP; Schedule P

attributes.name: payment_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative describing the purpose or nature of the payment (e.g., 'Partial settlement for dwelling damage', 'Attorney fee disbursement').
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Instrument or mechanism used to disburse funds to the payee (paper check, ACH, wire transfer, EFT, draft, or virtual card).
attributes.references: NACHA Operating Rules; PCI DSS; Guidewire BillingCenter

attributes.name: payment_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable payment reference number assigned by the claims payment system or AP module. Used for reconciliation and payee inquiries.

attributes.name: payment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the payment instrument. Tracks issuance through clearance, void, stop-payment, reissue, and return workflows in ClaimCenter.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter Payments Module; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: payment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the payment by financial category: indemnity (loss), medical, Loss Adjustment Expense (LAE), Defense & Cost Containment (DCC), Adjusting & Other (AO), or recovery offset.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P; SAP/SSAP No. 55; ISO

attributes.name: policy_year
attributes.description: Four-digit year of the policy period under which the loss is covered. Used for policy year (PY) loss development and reinsurance treaty year allocation.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P; Reinsurance treaty terms

attributes.name: reinsurance_recoverable_amount
attributes.description: Portion of this payment expected to be recovered from reinsurers under applicable treaty or facultative agreements. Used for net loss reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; SAP/SSAP No. 62R; IFRS 17; Reinsurance Management System

attributes.name: reissue_date
attributes.description: Date a replacement payment was reissued after a void or stop-payment. Links to the original payment via original_payment_id for audit trail.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: remittance_memo
attributes.description: Short memo line printed on the check or included in the EFT remittance advice to the payee. Typically includes claim number and coverage description.

attributes.name: siu_referral_flag
attributes.description: Indicates this payment was flagged for Special Investigations Unit (SIU) review due to suspected fraud. Payment may be held pending SIU clearance.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Insurance Fraud Act; Fraud Detection/SIU System; FCRA

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record from which this payment record was ingested into the lakehouse Silver layer.

attributes.name: state_jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code of the jurisdiction governing this payment for regulatory reporting and state DOI compliance purposes.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement; State DOI; NAIC Model Laws

attributes.name: stop_payment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates a stop-payment order has been placed on this check with the issuing bank. Triggers reissue workflow and outstanding check reconciliation.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter; Oracle/SAP AP Module; UCC Article 4

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this payment record. Used for incremental data pipeline processing and audit trail.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; Guidewire ClaimCenter; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: void_date
attributes.description: Date the payment was voided. Populated only when payment_status is Voided. Triggers reversal entries in the general ledger.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter; Oracle/SAP GL Module; SOX

attributes.name: withholding_amount
attributes.description: Amount withheld from the gross payment for tax withholding, Medicare Set-Aside (MSA), or other statutory deductions before net disbursement.
attributes.references: IRS Form 1099; Medicare Secondary Payer Act; SAP

products.name: recovery
products.description: Grain: one row per financial movement per claim exposure. Each record represents a single recovery transaction (Subrogation/Salvage/Reinsurance) recorded per Claim Exposure and Accounting Period.

attributes.name: recovery_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each claim recovery transaction. One row per recovery transaction per claim exposure per accounting period.

attributes.name: accounting_period_id
attributes.description: Reference to the accounting period in which this recovery transaction is recognized for statutory and GAAP financial reporting.

attributes.name: adjuster_id
attributes.description: Reference to the claims adjuster or recovery specialist responsible for managing and pursuing this recovery transaction.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: attorney_organization_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to party.organization. Business justification: Recovery (salvage, subrogation, reinsurance) often involves legal counsel. Law firms are organizations requiring full party attribution for vendor management, payment processing, and

attributes.name: cession_id
attributes.description: Reference to the reinsurance cession record when recovery_type is reinsurance. Null for subrogation and salvage recoveries.

attributes.name: claim_exposure_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific coverage line within the claim (Claim Exposure) against which this recovery is applied.

attributes.name: claim_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent claim record. Denormalized for direct claim-level reporting and aggregation without joining through claim exposure.

attributes.name: claim_payment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original claim payment transaction that this recovery offsets. Links recovery to the indemnity payment for net loss calculation.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter Payments module; SAP/SSAP No. 65

attributes.name: coverage_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to coverage.coverage. Business justification: Subrogation and salvage recoveries must tie to the coverage that paid the original loss for proper reserve relief, reinsurance accounting, and statutory reporting.

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.currency. Business justification: Multi-currency recovery operations (reinsurance collections, subrogation from foreign insurers, salvage auctions) require currency master for demand amount conversion, collection tracking

attributes.name: financial_transaction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to claimfinancials.financial_transaction. Business justification: Subrogation collections and salvage proceeds captured in recovery generate financial_transaction postings (recovery income, offset to paid losses).

attributes.name: line_of_business_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.line_of_business. Business justification: Subrogation and salvage recovery tracking, reinsurance recovery allocation, and net loss ratio calculation require LOB master for treaty participation rules, recovery expense

attributes.name: litigation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to claims.litigation. Business justification: Subrogation and other recoveries are frequently collected through litigation. recovery.litigation_flag confirms litigation is tracked on recoveries, but no FK exists.

attributes.name: policy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to policy.policy. Business justification: Recoveries (salvage and subrogation) reduce net incurred loss on specific policies. Policy linkage required for ultimate loss calculation, experience modification rating, and loss cost analysis.

attributes.name: policy_term_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to policy.term. Business justification: Recoveries must link to policy term for accurate net loss ratio calculations and to match recovery timing with the original loss term for loss development analysis.

attributes.name: responsible_party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the party from whom recovery is sought: tortfeasor for subrogation, salvage buyer for salvage, or reinsurer for reinsurance recovery.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter Subrogation module; ACORD standards

attributes.name: ri_agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the reinsurance agreement (treaty or facultative) under which a reinsurance recovery is claimed. Null for subrogation and salvage.
attributes.references: Sapiens ReinsurancePro; NAIC Schedule F; SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: ri_claim_cession_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reinsurance.ri_claim_cession. Business justification: Subrogation and salvage recoveries net against ceded losses at the claim-cession level for UNL calculation.

attributes.name: riskexposure_insured_risk_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to riskexposure.insured_risk. Business justification: Cross-LOB recovery reporting and Schedule P aggregation require linking recovery records to the parent insured risk.

attributes.name: salvage_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to claimfinancials.salvage. Business justification: Recovery is the transaction record for collected amounts. Salvage is the master record for salvage activity.

attributes.name: subrogation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to claimfinancials.subrogation. Business justification: Recovery is the transaction record for collected amounts. Subrogation is the master record for a subrogation pursuit.

attributes.name: accident_year
attributes.description: Calendar year in which the loss event occurred. Used for accident year (AY) loss development triangles and actuarial reserving analysis.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Schedule P; Actuarial Standards of Practice (ASOP)

attributes.name: bordereaux_period
attributes.description: YYYY-MM formatted period for which this recovery is included in reinsurance bordereaux reporting to the reinsurer. Applicable for reinsurance recoveries.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; Sapiens ReinsurancePro Bordereaux module; SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: closed_date
attributes.description: Date on which the recovery file was formally closed, either after full collection, settlement, or abandonment of pursuit.

attributes.name: collected_amount
attributes.description: Gross amount actually received from the responsible party or reinsurer prior to deducting collection expenses or attorney fees.
attributes.references: SAP/SSAP No. 65; NAIC Annual Statement; GAAP ASC 944

attributes.name: collected_date
attributes.description: Date on which recovery funds were actually received and posted. Null if recovery has not yet been collected.

attributes.name: collection_expense_amount
attributes.description: Costs incurred to pursue and collect the recovery, including attorney fees, court costs, and investigation expenses. Deducted to derive net recovery.
attributes.references: SAP/SSAP No. 65; NAIC Schedule P; ALAE/DCC definitions

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this recovery record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail, SOX compliance, and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: SOX; GLBA; NAIC Model Audit Rule (MAR)

attributes.name: demand_amount
attributes.description: Gross amount formally demanded from the responsible party or reinsurer. Represents the maximum expected recovery before negotiation or adjustment.
attributes.references: SAP/SSAP No. 65; NAIC Schedule P; GAAP ASC 944

attributes.name: demand_date
attributes.description: Date on which the formal demand for recovery was first issued to the responsible party, tortfeasor, or reinsurer.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter Subrogation module; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: General ledger account code to which this recovery transaction is posted for statutory and GAAP financial reporting.
attributes.references: SAP/SSAP No. 65; GAAP ASC 944; Oracle/SAP GL module

attributes.name: litigation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether legal action has been filed to pursue this recovery. True when a lawsuit or arbitration proceeding is active.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter Subrogation module; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: method
attributes.description: Mechanism used to pursue or collect the recovery. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: demand_letter|litigation|negotiated_settlement|auction|bordereaux|direct_bill — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter Subrogation module; NAIC Model Laws

attributes.name: net_amount
attributes.description: Net recovery amount after deducting collection expenses from collected amount. Used for statutory reporting and loss ratio calculations (NWP basis).
attributes.references: SAP/SSAP No. 65; NAIC Annual Statement Schedule P; GAAP ASC 944

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text narrative capturing adjuster commentary, negotiation history, legal strategy notes, or other contextual information about this recovery.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Externally visible business identifier for this recovery transaction, used in bordereaux reporting, correspondence, and audit trails.
attributes.references: ACORD data standards; NAIC Bordereaux Reporting

attributes.name: payment_reference
attributes.description: Check number, wire transfer reference, EFT trace number, or other payment instrument identifier for the collected recovery funds.
attributes.references: Guidewire BillingCenter; PCI DSS; GAAP ASC 944

attributes.name: policy_year
attributes.description: Year in which the policy that generated the claim was written. Used for policy year (PY) loss development and reinsurance treaty year allocation.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Schedule P; SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: recovery_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the recovery transaction: open (demand issued), collected (funds received), closed (finalized), void (cancelled), or disputed.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter Recovery module; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: recovery_type
attributes.description: Classifies the nature of the recovery: subrogation (pursuit of third-party tortfeasor), salvage (sale of damaged property), reinsurance (ceded loss recovery), or other.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement; SAP/SSAP No. 65; ISO P&C standards

attributes.name: ri_participation_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of the ceded loss recoverable from the reinsurer under the applicable treaty or facultative agreement (e.g., 0.7500 = 75%).
attributes.references: SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F; Sapiens ReinsurancePro Bordereaux

attributes.name: ri_recovery_basis
attributes.description: Reinsurance structure under which the recovery is claimed: quota share (QS), excess of loss (XOL), stop loss (SL), or facultative (FAC).
attributes.references: SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F; Sapiens ReinsurancePro

attributes.name: salvage_item_description
attributes.description: Description of the salvaged property or item sold, including condition, make/model for vehicles, or material type for property salvage.

attributes.name: salvage_type
attributes.description: Classification of salvage recovery: total loss vehicle, damaged property, scrap material, or auction proceeds. Applicable only when recovery_type is salvage.
attributes.references: ISO P&C standards; Guidewire ClaimCenter Salvage module

attributes.name: siu_referral_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this recovery has been referred to the Special Investigations Unit (SIU) for fraud investigation or suspicious activity review.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Insurance Fraud Act; Guidewire ClaimCenter SIU module

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record that originated this recovery transaction (e.g., ClaimCenter, ReinsurancePro, BillingCenter, or manual entry).
attributes.references: Data governance; SOX; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code for the jurisdiction governing this recovery, used for statutory reporting and state DOI regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement; State DOI regulations; ISO state codes

attributes.name: statute_of_limitations_date
attributes.description: Date by which legal action must be filed to preserve the right of recovery. Critical for subrogation diary management and SIU oversight.
attributes.references: State DOI regulations; NAIC Model Laws; FCRA

attributes.name: subrogation_basis
attributes.description: Legal theory under which subrogation is pursued: tort (negligence), contract (breach), statutory (workers comp lien), or equitable subrogation.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Laws; State DOI regulations; ISO P&C standards

attributes.name: transaction_date
attributes.description: The real-world date on which the recovery event occurred: demand issued, settlement agreed, payment received, or salvage sale completed.
attributes.references: SAP/SSAP No. 65; GAAP ASC 944; IFRS 17 para 38

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this recovery record. Used for change data capture, audit trail, and incremental ETL processing.
attributes.references: SOX; GLBA; NAIC Model Audit Rule (MAR)

products.name: subrogation
products.description: Master record for a subrogation pursuit against a liable third party. Tracks demand amount, collected amount, attorney assignment, litigation status, settlement date, and net recovery after expenses per claim.

attributes.name: subrogation_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the subrogation pursuit record. One row per subrogation action initiated against a liable third party arising from a paid claim.

attributes.name: accounting_period_id
attributes.description: Reference to the accounting period in which the subrogation recovery is recognized for statutory and GAAP financial reporting. Aligns with Schedule P accident year reporting.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 65; GAAP ASC 944; NAIC Schedule P; IFRS 17

attributes.name: attorney_organization_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to party.organization. Business justification: Law firms handling subrogation litigation are organizations in the party domain. Tracking counsel requires full organization details for billing, communication, and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: claim_exposure_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific coverage line (claim exposure) within the claim that generated the subrogation opportunity. Enables per-coverage recovery tracking.

attributes.name: claim_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent claim from which this subrogation pursuit originates. Links the recovery action to the underlying loss event and paid indemnity.

attributes.name: claimant_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to claims.claimant. Business justification: Subrogation recovery is pursued on behalf of the specific claimant who suffered the loss. Made-whole doctrine compliance and insured reimbursement calculations (insured_reimbursement_amount

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.currency. Business justification: Cross-border subrogation pursuits against foreign liable parties require currency master for demand amount calculation, settlement negotiation, collection tracking, and insured reimbursement

attributes.name: liable_party_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to party.party. Business justification: Subrogation pursues recovery from liable third parties who are tracked as party entities. Demand letters, settlement negotiations, and litigation require full party attribution including address

attributes.name: line_of_business_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.line_of_business. Business justification: Subrogation teams are organized by LOB (auto vs. property), recovery benchmarks and pursuit strategies differ by LOB, and regulatory subrogation reporting requires LOB attribution.

attributes.name: litigation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to claims.litigation. Business justification: Subrogation pursued through suit requires reference to the litigation record. subrogation.suit_filed_date, litigation_status, and statute_of_limitations_date confirm litigation is tracked

attributes.name: policy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to policy.policy. Business justification: Subrogation pursuits are policy-specific for tracking recovery potential, adjusting loss experience, and calculating net incurred amounts.

attributes.name: policy_term_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to policy.term. Business justification: Subrogation must link to policy term to match recovery collections with the original loss term for accurate loss development and net loss ratio reporting.

attributes.name: riskexposure_insured_risk_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to riskexposure.insured_risk. Business justification: Property subrogation (e.g., fire caused by contractor negligence) requires linking the pursuit record to the insured risk for cross-LOB subrogation reporting and reinsurance

attributes.name: arbitration_award_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount awarded by the arbitration panel in favor of the insurer. May differ from demand amount. Drives final collection and closure processing.
attributes.references: Arbitration Forums Inc.; SAP SSAP No. 65

attributes.name: arbitration_filing_date
attributes.description: Date the subrogation dispute was filed with the arbitration forum. Used to track filing deadlines and arbitration cycle times.

attributes.name: arbitration_forum
attributes.description: Arbitration body used for intercompany dispute resolution. Arbitration Forums Inc. is standard for auto subrogation. Drives filing fee tracking and award enforcement.
attributes.references: Arbitration Forums Inc.; AAA; JAMS; ISO Auto Subrogation Guidelines

attributes.name: closed_date
attributes.description: Date the subrogation pursuit was formally closed in the claims system. Used for cycle time reporting and recovery performance measurement.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: closure_reason
attributes.description: Reason the subrogation pursuit was closed. Required for recovery analytics, SIU referral decisions, and regulatory reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: promote to reference product if values expand]
attributes.references: NAIC Market Conduct Standards; Guidewire ClaimCenter

attributes.name: collected_amount
attributes.description: Total gross amount actually received from the liable party or their insurer to date. Cumulative across all payments. Used in net recovery and loss ratio calculations.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P; SAP SSAP No. 65; GAAP ASC 944

attributes.name: collectible_amount
attributes.description: Estimated collectible portion of the demand amount after applying comparative negligence, policy limits of the liable party, and asset assessment. Used for reserve adequacy.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P; SAP SSAP No. 65; Actuarial Standards of Practice

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the subrogation record was first created in the claims management system. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and SOX compliance.

attributes.name: demand_amount
attributes.description: Gross dollar amount demanded from the liable third party, typically equal to total indemnity paid plus allocated loss adjustment expenses (ALAE) on the claim.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P; SAP SSAP No. 65; Guidewire ClaimCenter

attributes.name: demand_date
attributes.description: Date the formal subrogation demand letter was issued to the liable party or their insurer. Starts the statute of limitations clock for recovery actions.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Laws; State DOI Regulations

attributes.name: insured_reimbursement_amount
attributes.description: Portion of the net recovery returned to the insured, typically representing their deductible or uninsured loss. Required by the made-whole doctrine in most jurisdictions.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Laws; State DOI Regulations; Made-Whole Doctrine

attributes.name: last_activity_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent action taken on the subrogation file (demand, payment received, court filing, etc.). Used for diary management and dormant file identification.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: liable_party_claim_number
attributes.description: Claim number assigned by the liable party's insurer for the same loss event. Enables cross-carrier reconciliation and arbitration tracking.
attributes.references: Arbitration Forums Inc.; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: liable_party_insurer
attributes.description: Name of the insurance carrier for the liable third party. Used to route intercompany arbitration and direct demand letters to the correct carrier.
attributes.references: NAIC Company Code Registry; Arbitration Forums Inc.

attributes.name: liable_party_policy_number
attributes.description: Policy number of the liable third party's insurance coverage. Required for intercompany arbitration filings and demand correspondence.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; Arbitration Forums Inc.

attributes.name: litigation_status
attributes.description: Current stage of legal proceedings for the subrogation pursuit. Drives reserve adequacy reviews and legal expense forecasting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: promote to reference product if stages expand]
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter; NAIC Market Conduct Standards; State Court Rules

attributes.name: made_whole_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the insured has been fully compensated for their loss before the insurer may retain subrogation proceeds. Required by the made-whole doctrine in most states.
attributes.references: Made-Whole Doctrine; State DOI Regulations; NAIC Model Laws

attributes.name: negligence_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of fault attributed to the liable third party as determined by investigation or adjudication. Drives the collectible amount calculation under comparative negligence statutes.
attributes.references: State Tort Law; NAIC Model Laws; ISO Claims Guidelines

attributes.name: net_recovery_amount
attributes.description: Net recovery after deducting recovery expenses from collected amount (collected_amount minus recovery_expense_amount). Represents the actual financial benefit to the insurer.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P; SAP SSAP No. 65; GAAP ASC 944

attributes.name: next_action_date
attributes.description: Diary date for the next required action on the subrogation file. Drives case management queues and ensures statute of limitations compliance.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text narrative capturing key developments, negotiation history, legal strategy, and adjuster observations for the subrogation pursuit. Supports case management and audit.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Externally visible business identifier for the subrogation pursuit, used in demand letters, court filings, and bordereaux reporting. Format: SUBR-YYYY-NNNNNNN.

attributes.name: opened_date
attributes.description: Date the subrogation pursuit was formally opened in the claims management system. Used as the start point for cycle time and recovery lag analysis.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: pursuit_status
attributes.description: Current workflow state of the subrogation pursuit. Drives case management queues and recovery reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Open|Demand Issued|Negotiating|Settled|Collected|Closed - No Recovery|Referred to Litigation — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter Recovery Module; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: recovery_expense_amount
attributes.description: Total allocated expenses incurred in pursuing the subrogation recovery, including attorney fees, court costs, and investigation costs (DCC/ALAE). Deducted to compute net recovery.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P; SAP SSAP No. 65; GAAP ASC 944

attributes.name: recovery_method
attributes.description: Mechanism used to pursue the subrogation recovery. Intercompany Arbitration applies to auto claims under Arbitration Forum agreements. Drives legal cost allocation.
attributes.references: Arbitration Forums Inc.; ISO; Guidewire ClaimCenter

attributes.name: referral_date
attributes.description: Date the subrogation file was referred to outside counsel or a subrogation vendor for legal pursuit. Triggers DCC expense tracking and litigation status updates.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: reinsurance_recovery_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether a portion of the subrogation recovery must be remitted to reinsurers per cession agreements. Triggers reinsurance bordereaux reporting and recovery allocation.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F; Reinsurance Management System

attributes.name: settlement_amount
attributes.description: Agreed gross settlement amount with the liable party. May differ from demand amount due to negotiation, comparative negligence, or policy limits of the liable party.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter; SAP SSAP No. 65; GAAP ASC 944

attributes.name: settlement_date
attributes.description: Date a settlement agreement was reached with the liable party or their insurer. Triggers final payment processing and closure of the subrogation pursuit.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter; SAP SSAP No. 65; GAAP ASC 944

attributes.name: siu_referral_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subrogation file has been referred to the Special Investigations Unit (SIU) for fraud investigation related to the liable party or loss circumstances.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Insurance Fraud Act; State DOI Anti-Fraud Regulations; Guidewire ClaimCenter SIU Module

attributes.name: state_of_loss
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code where the loss occurred. Determines applicable subrogation statutes, comparative negligence rules, and statute of limitations periods.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Laws; State DOI Regulations; ISO Territory Codes

attributes.name: statute_of_limitations_date
attributes.description: Date by which legal action must be filed to preserve the subrogation right. Calculated from loss date per applicable state statute. Critical for diary and case management.
attributes.references: State DOI Regulations; NAIC Model Laws; State Tort Statutes

attributes.name: subrogation_type
attributes.description: Legal basis of the recovery action: Subrogation (insurer steps into insured's rights), Contribution (recovery from co-insurer), or Indemnification (contractual hold-harmless recovery).
attributes.references: ISO Insurance Subrogation Guidelines; NAIC Model Laws

attributes.name: suit_filed_date
attributes.description: Date the subrogation lawsuit was filed in court. Marks the transition from pre-litigation to litigation phase and triggers enhanced reserve and expense tracking.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the subrogation record. Used for change data capture, audit trail, and incremental ETL processing in the lakehouse.

products.name: salvage
products.description: Grain: one row per salvage financial movement per claim exposure. Records proceeds recovered by taking title to damaged property. FK to claim_exposure_id and accounting_period_id. PK: salvage_id.

attributes.name: salvage_id
attributes.description: Represents the salvage id value associated with the salvage entity in the claimfinancials domain.

attributes.name: accounting_period_id
attributes.description: Reference to the accounting period in which salvage proceeds are recognized for statutory and GAAP reporting.
attributes.references: SAP/SSAP No. 55; US GAAP ASC 944; IFRS 17

attributes.name: buyer_party_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to party.party. Business justification: Salvage buyers (auto auctions, scrap dealers) must be tracked as parties for 1099 tax reporting, OFAC screening, and fraud detection.

attributes.name: catastrophe_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to catastrophegeography.catastrophe_event. Business justification: salvage.catastrophe_code is a denormalized string representing the catastrophe_event entity.

attributes.name: claim_exposure_id
attributes.description: Represents the claim exposure id value associated with the salvage entity in the claimfinancials domain.

attributes.name: claim_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent claim under which this salvage activity is recorded.

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.currency. Business justification: Salvage auction proceeds, storage costs, and net salvage calculations require currency master for multi-currency total loss settlements, reinsurance salvage share allocation, and functional

attributes.name: insured_risk_id
attributes.description: Reference to the insured risk (vehicle, property, etc.) that is the subject of salvage disposition.

attributes.name: line_of_business_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.line_of_business. Business justification: Salvage disposition processes and recovery rates differ materially by LOB (auto total-loss vs. commercial property salvage).

attributes.name: policy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to policy.policy. Business justification: Salvage items are recovered from specific policy losses for net loss calculation, total loss determination, and deductible application. Policy linkage required for accurate loss cost analysis.

attributes.name: policy_term_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to policy.term. Business justification: Salvage must link to policy term to match salvage proceeds with the original loss term for accurate net loss ratio and loss development reporting.

attributes.name: riskexposure_property_risk_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to riskexposure.property_risk. Business justification: Salvage teams coordinate property demolition, environmental remediation, and land sale with specific property characteristics.

attributes.name: riskexposure_vehicle_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to riskexposure.vehicle. Business justification: Salvage vendors require VIN, title number, and vehicle specifications for auction processing and title transfer.

attributes.name: vendor_payee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to claimfinancials.payee. Business justification: Salvage has vendor_name and vendor_code (STRING) for the salvage vendor (auction house, salvage yard). Vendors are payees. Adding vendor_payee_id FK normalizes vendor master data.

attributes.name: assigned_date
attributes.description: Date the salvage item was formally assigned to the salvage vendor or auction house for disposition.

attributes.name: auction_date
attributes.description: Date on which the salvaged item was auctioned or sold. Used to align proceeds recognition with the correct accounting period.

attributes.name: auction_fee
attributes.description: Fee charged by the auction house or salvage vendor for facilitating the sale, deducted from gross proceeds to arrive at net salvage.

attributes.name: auction_proceeds
attributes.description: Gross cash proceeds received from the auction or direct sale of the salvaged item before deducting storage, towing, and auction fees.
attributes.references: SAP/SSAP No. 55; NAIC Schedule P; US GAAP ASC 944

attributes.name: buyer_type
attributes.description: Classification of the salvage buyer. Determines applicable title transfer rules and tax reporting obligations.

attributes.name: certificate_number
attributes.description: Certificate of destruction or salvage certificate number issued by the state DMV or relevant authority for the disposed item.
attributes.references: State DMV regulations; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: closed_date
attributes.description: Date the salvage activity was closed, indicating all proceeds collected, title transferred, and financials reconciled.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the salvage record was first created in the claims management system.
attributes.references: SOX; GLBA; Guidewire ClaimCenter audit trail

attributes.name: disposition_method
attributes.description: Method by which the salvaged item is disposed of. Impacts net salvage calculation and title transfer obligations.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter; state DOI total-loss regulations

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: GL account code to which the net salvage proceeds are posted in the statutory and GAAP general ledger.
attributes.references: SAP/SSAP No. 55; Oracle/SAP GL module; SOX

attributes.name: insured_retained_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the insured elected to retain the salvaged item, resulting in a deduction from the total-loss settlement payment.
attributes.references: ISO PAP/CA forms; state DOI total-loss regulations

attributes.name: insured_retention_deduction
attributes.description: Amount deducted from the total-loss settlement when the insured elects to retain the salvaged item, equal to the salvage value estimate.
attributes.references: ISO PAP/CA forms; SAP/SSAP No. 55; state DOI regulations

attributes.name: item_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the salvaged item including make, model, year, condition, or property type to support valuation and disposition.

attributes.name: net_salvage_amount
attributes.description: Net proceeds from salvage after deducting storage, towing, and auction fees from gross auction proceeds. Credited against claim payments.
attributes.references: SAP/SSAP No. 55; NAIC Schedule P; US GAAP ASC 944; IFRS 17

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text adjuster notes capturing disposition decisions, buyer negotiations, title issues, or other relevant salvage activity details.

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Externally visible business identifier for the salvage record, used in bordereaux, vendor communications, and regulatory filings.

attributes.name: reinsurance_recoverable_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether a portion of the net salvage proceeds is recoverable by or creditable to a reinsurer under treaty or facultative agreement.
attributes.references: SAP/SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F; Sapiens ReinsurancePro

attributes.name: reinsurance_salvage_share
attributes.description: Portion of net salvage proceeds attributable to reinsurers under applicable treaty or facultative agreement, per SSAP No. 62R.
attributes.references: SAP/SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F; IFRS 17

attributes.name: salvage_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the salvage activity. Drives workflow in ClaimCenter Recovery module and financial recognition timing.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter Recovery module; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: salvage_type
attributes.description: Classification of the salvage by asset category. Determines applicable disposition rules, title transfer requirements, and accounting treatment.
attributes.references: ISO forms; NAIC Annual Statement instructions

attributes.name: siu_referral_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this salvage activity has been referred to the SIU for fraud investigation (e.g., staged total loss).
attributes.references: NAIC Model Insurance Fraud Act; Guidewire ClaimCenter SIU module

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code where the salvage activity occurs, used for state DOI reporting and title transfer jurisdiction.
attributes.references: NAIC state codes; state DOI regulations; USPS state abbreviations

attributes.name: storage_cost
attributes.description: Cumulative cost of storing the salvaged item from date of loss to date of disposition, deducted from gross proceeds.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter Expense module; SAP/SSAP No. 55

attributes.name: storage_end_date
attributes.description: Date the salvaged item was removed from storage upon sale, transfer, or destruction.

attributes.name: storage_location
attributes.description: Address or facility name where the salvaged item is stored pending auction or disposition.

attributes.name: storage_start_date
attributes.description: Date the salvaged item entered storage, used to calculate accrued storage costs and vendor billing.

attributes.name: title_number
attributes.description: State-issued salvage title number assigned to the vehicle or property after total-loss declaration, required for legal resale.
attributes.references: State DMV regulations; state DOI total-loss rules

attributes.name: title_received_date
